title: Head of Social Strategy
description:
Head of Social Strategy (we’re hiring a real Head of Social, not a social media manager)

Remote | Full-time



Own the social strategy for exciting new launches in toys & games



We're an established toys and games brand, coming off the back of one of the most successful sport-related backyard game products in the category. We're now transitioning into a wider sports-related toys and games company, speed running zero to one million customers over the next three years.



We're assembling a team of highly talented people to own each department, and this role is one of them.



Our thesis: anyone can copy a product. Nobody can copy a fan base.



The great modern game brands aren't selling objects in boxes. They're building platforms, and social content is how they do it:



-Spikeball took a backyard game and turned it into a genuine sport: active players, in-person events, and a real community.

-Popdarts took a simple table game and now kids call themselves Popdarts players, build Instagram handles around it, and show up to live events. It's become a niche sport in its own right.

-Exploding Kittens built a cult following of fans who wait for every new game and drop. A franchise, not a one-off product.

-Golf Daddy and Bucket Golf haven't built community at that level, but they've built huge social followings around their product and their game, proof of how far pure content can carry a brand.



That spectrum — from big social following all the way to genuine sport with real-world events — is exactly the playbook we're running across our portfolio.



For each of our hero products, this role strategies and owns the build: where on that spectrum the brand should live, and how content, community, and drops get it there.



The Role



You are the strategist and owner of organic growth across the entire portfolio.



This is not a traditional social media manager role. You're not simply scheduling posts or managing an existing content calendar.



You'll design the strategies and be accountable for getting them shipped and hitting numbers, working through creators, clippers, editors, and affiliate armies.



You'll own things like:



-Building our flagship new launch into a platform brand. Target: 250K Instagram followers, with an audience hooked on updates and drops.

-A short-form machine across TikTok, Reels, and Shorts. Target: 1 billion cumulative organic views portfolio-wide.

-The affiliate engine. This is central to how we'll grow. Traditional UGC and content sourcing is slow: one creator, one brief, one video at a time. Hudson Leogrande's brand Comfrt revolutionized it by building an army of affiliates on TikTok Shop, hundreds of core creators posting daily and thousands more on open enrollment, generating a torrent of content that then fuels Meta, Instagram, and AppLovin paid acquisition. That is the system we're building. Ideally you've worked with this model before; if not, you'll work with the team and founders on running it.

-Turning a product into a sport. Building a fan base and community from zero, with a roadmap to real-world events and competition.

-Creative that stands out. Coming up with ideas and running shoots that make our brands impossible to scroll past. We're always generating content that stands out, not doing the same as every other brand on Instagram.

-Monthly reporting to the founders. Growth, views, affiliate revenue, community, learnings, and next moves.



Why This Is a Rare Opportunity



-Whole-portfolio ownership from day one. You're not inheriting someone else's playbook or optimizing a mature account. You're writing the strategy for multiple new category launches, with the founders as your only stakeholders.

-Proven engine behind you. This isn't zero-to-one on a maybe. The existing brand does eight figures, paid acquisition is firing, and the products are already built. But great paid acquisition runs on a constant supply of high-level content, and generating that is exactly what this role owns. The organic flywheel is the missing piece, and the moat.

-Category timing. Physical games and backyard sports are having a generational moment, and short-form is how they blow up. The right operator here gets to put their name on category-defining launches.

-Lean, global, AI-first team where speed wins, shipping beats meetings, and you have direct access to both founders.



Who We're Looking For



-You've personally grown a brand or creator account to six-figures+ followers and can show us the account and the numbers.

-You've built or run an affiliate, clipper, or TikTok Shop creator program with revenue attached. Direct experience with the -Comfrt-style affiliate model is a major advantage; at minimum you need a genuine understanding of how it works and why it wins.

title: AI AVATAR VIDEO CREATOR
description:
Avatar Creator (Google Flow / Veo 3.1) – Ecommerce UGC



Part-Time | $3-4 per video + Performance Bonuses + Raises



We are hiring 1 more AI Avatar Creator to join our growing ecommerce content team.



IMPORTANT: We are ONLY looking for applicants with previous experience using Google Flow and Veo 3.1 to create AI avatar videos and ecommerce UGC content.



If you have never used Google Flow or Veo 3.1, please do not apply.



About Us



We create AI pages on Instagram and
 that promote products through engaging AI avatar videos.



You will NOT be writing scripts.



Every day you will receive:



* Finished script

* Product information

* Creative direction

* Reference videos

* Brand guidelines



Your job is to transform those scripts into realistic, engaging AI UGC videos that look authentic and convert viewers into buyers.



Responsibilities



• Create AI avatar videos using Google Flow and Veo 3.1

• Produce realistic ecommerce UGC content

• Generate product scenes and supporting B-roll

• Use HeyGen when needed

• Edit videos in CapCut

• Add captions, music, transitions, and effects

• Match our editing style

• Organize completed work in Google Drive

• Communicate daily regarding progress



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



Applicants MUST have experience with:



Google Flow



Veo 3.1 or Omni Flash



AI Avatar creation



Ecommerce UGC videos



CapCut



Preferred experience:



Google flow/capcut/claude



Requirements



• Strong English comprehension

• Strong internet connection

• Reliable computer

• Reliable power supply

• Excellent attention to detail

• Able to follow detailed instructions

• Available 5 days per week

• Able to communicate daily



Expected Workload



Approximately 3–5 videos per day, depending on complexity.



Compensation



• $3-4 per video. Starting pay depending on complexity.

• Performance bonuses

• $50 bonus for every 1 million combined Instagram +
 views on videos you create

• Raises based on performance

• Long-term growth opportunities



REQUIRED APPLICATION QUESTIONS



1. How long have you been using Google Flow?

2. How long have you been using Veo 3.1 or Omni Flash?

3. Have you created AI avatar UGC videos before?

4. Please provide 3–5 examples of AI avatar videos you have personally created.

5. Which AI tools do you use most often?

6. Which editing software do you use?

7. What is your internet speed?

8. How many hours per day are you available?



REQUIRED SKILLS TEST



Applications without the assignment will NOT be considered.



Google Drive:





Using the provided assets:



• Recreate the reference video as closely as possible.

• Match the editing style.

• Match the pacing.

• Use an AI avatar.

• Add captions.

• Export in 9:16 format.



You may use:



• Google Flow

• Veo 3.1

• HeyGen

• Gemini

• CapCut

• Any other AI tools you already own



When finished:



1. Upload the completed video to Google Drive.

2. Set sharing permissions to Anyone with the link can view.

3. Include the Google Drive link in your application.



IMPORTANT



To show that you read this entire post, begin your application with:



Matthew AI Creator



Applications that do not begin with these words will not be considered.



PLEASE INCLUDE PREVIOUS SAMPLES OF AI AVATAR CONTENT IN YOUR APPLICATION



We are looking for reliable people who want to grow with our company long-term.

title: Help Desk Manager — US-Based MSP
description:
We are a Managed Service Provider (MSP) based in the Chicago suburbs (Illinois, USA). We provide IT support, Microsoft 365 management, cybersecurity, and backup/disaster recovery to small and mid-sized businesses across the Chicagoland area, including some clients in regulated industries.



We're a tight-knit, growing team and we're looking for a Help Desk Manager to help us deliver great service to our clients every day. You'll work closely with the owner and be a key part of our leadership as we grow.



This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll manage the ticket queue, but just as importantly, you'll actively mentor and develop our technicians, handle the more complex technical issues they escalate to you, and continuously raise the quality of our service. Our current technicians are capable and self-sufficient on day-to-day work — we're looking for someone who can take them to the next level while owning the harder problems and keeping our whole operation running smoothly.





WHAT YOU'LL DO:



Service Desk Operations:

- Manage the daily ticket queue in Autotask — prioritize, assign, and keep work moving

- Make sure tickets are resolved on time and clients are kept in the loop

- Spot recurring problems and work with the team to fix them for good

- Keep an eye on monitoring alerts and make sure nothing slips through



Team Development and Mentorship:

- Coach and mentor our technicians, actively helping them build new skills and grow into more complex work

- Identify skill gaps on the team and create clear paths to close them

- Review resolved tickets to find learning and improvement opportunities

- Run knowledge-sharing sessions and document best practices for the team

- Set technical standards and help the team consistently meet them

- Take our capable technicians and make them great



Client Relationships:

- Be a friendly, reliable point of contact for our clients

- Keep clients updated on their open issues

- Help resolve concerns before they become bigger problems

- Work alongside the owner on client reviews and building strong relationships



Technical Escalations and Higher-Tier Work:

- Serve as the escalation point for issues the L1/L2 team can't resolve

- Handle complex work involving Microsoft 365, Exchange, Intune, Conditional Access, Azure/Entra ID, and Active Directory

- Own root-cause analysis so recurring problems get fixed permanently, not just patched over

- Guide our field technician during onsite visits over Microsoft Teams

- Coordinate with vendors on tougher technical issues



Documentation, Process, and Quality:

- Keep IT Glue documentation accurate, complete, and useful

- Build and maintain SOPs so common issues get resolved consistently across the team

- Review ticket quality and documentation standards, and coach the team to improve

- Identify automation and efficiency opportunities to reduce repetitive work

- Contribute ideas to make our service better as we grow





The Partnership:

The owner is actively involved in the business every day — working with clients, driving growth, and supporting the team. You won't be left on an island. This role is about working together to build something great. As we grow, this role grows too, with real opportunity to shape how our service delivery works and to lead a larger team over time.





OUR TOOL STACK (experience with these is a big plus):

- Autotask PSA (ticketing and time tracking)

- Datto RMM

- NinjaOne (remote monitoring and management)

- IT Glue (documentation)

- Microsoft 365 Business Premium (Intune, Conditional Access, Exchange, Azure/Entra ID)

- Datto BCDR and SaaS Protection (backup)

- Huntress (managed EDR / security)

- Auvik (network monitoring)

- Fortinet firewalls & switches

- Cisco Merkaki hardware





WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:



- At least 4 years working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment

- Some experience leading or coordinating a helpdesk/service desk team

- Hands-on experience with a PSA tool (Autotask, ConnectWise, Halo, or similar)

- Hands-on experience with an RMM tool (NinjaOne, Datto RMM, ConnectWise Automate, N-able, or similar)

- Experience with a documentation platform (IT Glue, Hudu, or similar)

- Solid Microsoft 365 administration skills

- Excellent written and spoken English — you'll talk with US clients by
, phone, and Teams

- Able to work US Central Time business hours 

- Reliable high-speed internet and a professional home office setup





NICE TO HAVE:



- Experience specifically with Autotask, NinjaOne, and IT Glue

- Microsoft certifications (MS-900, AZ-900, SC-900, or higher)

- Experience with Datto BCDR, Huntress, or FortiGate

- Experience supporting clients in regulated industries (healthcare, finance, etc.)

- PowerShell scripting

- ITIL familiarity





HOW TO APPLY:



To show us you've read this posting, please start your application with the word "MANAGED" and answer these three questions:



1. Which PSA and RMM tools have you used, and for how long?

2. Tell us about your experience in an MSP and any team you've supported or led.

3. What is your expected monthly salary in USD?



We read every application that follows these steps. We'll share more about our company, clients, and team during the interview process. We're excited to find the right person to grow with us.



We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Paid Media Specialist (Google)
description:
We are seeking a skilled and results-driven Paid Media Specialist (Google) to oversee, manage, and optimize advertising campaigns on Google Ads platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Google Ads, audience targeting, and analytics tools, with the ability to translate marketing goals into effective campaigns that drive measurable results.



Key Responsibilities:

- Develop, implement, and optimize Google AdWords campaigns across multiple platforms, ensuring alignment with overall business goals and maximizing return on investment (ROI).

- Monitor and analyze campaign performance data, including click-through rates (CTR), conversion rates, and cost-per-click (CPC), to drive continuous improvements and strategic adjustments.

- Create detailed reports on campaign performance, advertising spend, and revenue generation, offering insights for data-driven decision-making and optimization.

- Conduct in-depth keyword research and audience targeting to enhance ad relevance, ensuring the highest possible impact and engagement across Google Search, Display, and YouTube networks.

- Stay up-to-date with the latest Google Ads features, industry trends, and best practices to ensure campaigns remain innovative and competitive.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align ad strategies with broader marketing objectives, providing input for integrated campaigns and content development.

- Manage ad budgets effectively, ensuring optimal allocation of resources across campaigns while maintaining cost-efficiency.

- Test and refine ad creatives, landing pages, and bidding strategies to improve campaign outcomes and user experience.

- Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to ad performance, ensuring timely and effective solutions to minimize campaign downtime or inefficiencies.

- Partner with internal teams and stakeholders to implement new tools, technologies, and automation processes that enhance ad performance and operational efficiency.



Qualifications:

- At least 2 years of AdWords experience, demonstrating proficiency in campaign creation, optimization, and analysis.

- Strong knowledge of Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Search Engine Marketing (SEM), and Paid Search (PPC), with a solid understanding of how they interrelate.

- Google Ads certification is required to validate expertise in the platform.

- Experience working in a marketing agency is a plus, offering exposure to diverse client needs and fast-paced project environments.



What We Offer:

- Competitive salary base

- Permanent remote setup

- Unlimited free access to MAG School courses and SOP Library

- Opportunities for professional development and career advancement

title: AI-Assisted Software Developer
description:
ABOUT SHOP MARKETING PROS:

We are a marketing agency based in the United States with a stateside and international team of 50 professionals. Shop Marketing Pros is a very well-respected and rapidly growing Digital Marketing Company in the Automotive Repair Industry with strong core values and a superb track record of serving its clients better than competitors. Our key services include customized Website Design, Digital Advertising, Search Engine Optimization, and Social Media Management. 



We are now investing heavily in proprietary software. We are building internal and client-facing

platforms that will improve our agency’s operations, help clients understand their marketing

results, and create new capabilities for the future.



Our Core Values are of incredible importance to us. We live by our “SHIELD” so please visit 
/core-values/ and familiarize yourself with our Core Values before continuing. Please continue with this job description and application if you feel you align with these values.





COMPANY BENEFITS + PERKS:

1) This is a full-time, permanent, remote position from Monday to Friday, 8 am to 4 pm Central Time.

2) 13th Month Pay

3) Unlimited PTO (after 3 months of employment)

4) Eight (8) Paid Holiday Leaves (Filipino Holidays)

5) Paid time off beginning Christmas Eve until New Year’s Day (we plan to continue offering this as long as it is feasible)

6) An extraordinary team/company culture





JOB DESCRIPTION:

Shop Marketing Pros is seeking an AI-Assisted Software Developer to work directly with our Founder & CEO as part of a small software development team. You will help design, build, and maintain proprietary software—including marketing attribution platforms, reporting dashboards, internal business systems, WordPress plugins, automations, and third-party integrations—that improve our operations and deliver greater value to our clients.



This is not a traditional software development role, nor is it simply a prompting or no-code automation position. Success in this role requires a strong understanding of software development fundamentals and the ability to use AI coding tools effectively to plan, build, test, troubleshoot, and improve software. We are looking for someone who can think critically, exercise sound technical judgment, and confidently recommend better solutions when needed while helping turn business goals into scalable, maintainable software.





REQUIRED SKILLS:

The ideal candidate

Has experience building production-ready software using AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Windsurf, or similar AI coding agents.

Understands the fundamentals of GitHub, databases, APIs, webhooks, front-end and back-end development, and overall application architecture.

Can translate business goals into clear implementation plans for AI coding agents.

Understands when information belongs in a database, JSON file, configuration file, documentation, or another storage solution.

Can determine when custom software is the right solution versus using automation platforms such as n8n, Zapier, Make, or existing third-party services.

Reviews AI-generated code critically instead of assuming it is correct.

Can thoroughly test, troubleshoot, and improve AI-generated software.

Understands relational databases, SQL, tables, relationships, and migrations.

Understands APIs, authentication, JSON, webhooks, and third-party integrations.

Can read logs, identify errors, and troubleshoot software issues effectively.

Tests software thoroughly rather than assuming that functionality is reliable after a single successful test.

Thinks critically about how technical decisions affect the broader system architecture.

Works independently with minimal supervision while taking ownership of completed work.

Communicates clearly and professionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Knows when additional research, expert review, or a second opinion is necessary before making technical decisions.

Possesses strong analytical thinking, research abilities, and problem-solving skills.



Not Required, but helpful:

Experience with the following technologies

TypeScript and JavaScript

React and Next.js

Supabase and PostgreSQL

Vercel

WordPress and PHP

n8n, Zapier, or Make

Multi-tenant SaaS applications

Authentication, permissions, and row-level security

Digital marketing platforms, reporting systems, attribution software, or agency operations

Experience with comparable technologies is acceptable if you have strong fundamentals and

can learn our stack quickly.





JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

Help plan, design, build, test, deploy, and maintain proprietary software applications.

Use AI coding agents to accelerate software development while maintaining quality, security, and maintainability.

Translate business requirements into well-defined technical implementation tasks.

Review AI-generated code, identify questionable assumptions, and recommend better technical approaches.

title: Creative Strategist / Senior Ad Editor – Dropshipping & Meta Ads About the Role
description:
We are building a performance-focused dropshipping operation across multiple international markets and are looking for an experienced Creative Strategist / Senior Ad Editor to help us build our creative department.



This is NOT a traditional branding position.



Our business is built around fast product testing, competitor research, high-quality creative execution and systematic scaling of winning products.



Creative output is one of the most important parts of our entire operation. We are therefore looking for someone who understands both sides:



Strategy + Execution.



You should understand how to find winning concepts, turn them into structured tests, create clear Creative Briefs and work hands-on with editors to produce high-quality ads.



Initially, this position will start on a smaller scale as a test phase. If the collaboration and results are strong, the goal is to develop this into a long-term Creative Team Lead position and build the creative team together.



How Our Creative Testing Works



Understanding our process is important.



Stage 1: Product Testing



When testing a new product, we start with proven competitor ads.



These creatives need to be recreated and localized at a very high standard.



We care about:



Accurate localization and translation

High-quality video and image execution

Matching the original creative structure

Matching the pacing, voiceover and overall feel of the reference

Correct product, offer and funnel information

Clean and professional execution



The goal is not to unnecessarily reinvent a proven concept during the initial test.



The goal is to create a high-quality version of an already validated creative so we can properly test the product and offer.



Stage 2: Scaling Winning Products



Once a product passes our initial testing phase, creative strategy becomes much more important.



You will:



Find additional competitor ads and concepts

Research competitors continuously

Identify new hooks and angles

Analyze existing winning ads

Create iterations of winning creatives

Build structured A/B tests

Write Creative Briefs for editors

Coordinate production of new ads



We don't want random creative variations.



Every new creative should have a reason for being tested and, where possible, isolate variables so we can understand what actually improved or hurt performance.



Stage 3: Expanding Beyond Competitor Ads



Eventually, competitor creatives alone are not enough.



At this stage, you should be able to expand the creative library through:



Reinterpreting winning ads from other products or markets

Taking proven creative structures and applying a different angle

Developing new concepts from scratch

Using current market and advertising trends

Following our internal SOPs and frameworks

Creating new hooks, angles and formats based on actual performance data



The objective is to continuously increase creative output without simply producing more of the same.



Awareness & Funnel Understanding



You should understand that not every customer needs to see the same message.



Experience with concepts such as:



Customer Awareness Stages

Top of Funnel (TOF)

Middle of Funnel (MOF)

Bottom of Funnel (BOF)

Problem-aware vs. solution-aware audiences

Different hooks and angles for different levels of awareness



is important.



When developing new concepts, we want our creative library to cover different awareness stages instead of targeting every customer with the same message.



Your Responsibilities

Creative Research & Strategy

Research competitors and their advertising

Find strong reference ads for new product tests

Identify winning hooks, angles and creative structures

Monitor creative trends in the market

Analyze existing winners and develop new iterations

Create structured Creative Briefs

Plan A/B tests and creative variations

Develop concepts from scratch when competitor material becomes limited

Creative Production



You must also be comfortable working hands-on.



You should be able to:



Recreate competitor creatives at a high standard

Produce Meta video and image ads

Edit voiceovers, subtitles, visuals and pacing

Work with UGC and existing media

Create AI-generated assets when required

Turn Creative Briefs into finished ads

Quality Control



A major part of this position is ensuring that our creative output maintains a consistently high standard.



You will review creatives for:



Translation and localization quality

Visual accuracy

Voiceover quality

Pacing and editing

Correct offers and product information

Consistency with the reference or Creative Brief

Overall readiness before creatives go live

Building the Creative Team



This role starts hands-on.



We are NOT looking for someone who only wants to manage other people.



However, our long-term goal is to build a dedicated creative team around this position.



If the test phase is successful, you will have the opportunity to become our Creative Team Lead.



Together, we will:



Hire additional editors

Build efficient workflows

Create and improve SOPs

Assign Creative Briefs

Review editor output

Maintain quality standards

Increase daily creative output

Develop a scalable creative production system across different markets



If you already know talented editors or other potential creative team members you have successfully worked with before, that is a strong plus.



Experience We're Looking For



Ideally, you already have experience with:



Dropshipping

Meta /
 Ads

Performance creative production

Creative strategy

Competitor ad research

Creative Brief creation

Direct-response advertising

Creative testing and A/B testing

Awareness stages and funnel concepts

Scaling winning products through additional creatives



Previous experience working inside a high-volume dropshipping operation or performance marketing team is a major advantage.



Tools



You should be comfortable with modern creative production tools such as:



CapCut

Adobe Premiere Pro / Photoshop or similar

ElevenLabs

Higgsfield

Magnific

Freepik

AI image and video generation tools



You don't need to know every tool we use from day one.



More important is that you understand how to use modern AI and editing tools to achieve high-quality output quickly and efficiently.



Who We're Looking For



You should be someone who:



Understands the dropshipping testing and scaling environment

Thinks strategically but is still willing to execute

Has a strong eye for performance creatives

Can distinguish between copying a winner and strategically iterating a winner

Understands Creative Briefs

Understands A/B testing

Can work quickly without sacrificing quality

Is highly organized and reliable

Takes ownership

Communicates clearly in English

Can eventually coordinate and lead other editors



We care less about cinematic editing and more about your ability to create high-quality ads that are built to convert.



Long-Term Opportunity



We are starting this position at a smaller scale to test the collaboration, workflow and results.



If it works, this is intended to become a long-term position with significantly more responsibility.



Our goal is to build a creative department capable of supporting multiple products and markets with a consistently high creative output.



For the right person, this means the opportunity to grow from a hands-on Creative Strategist into the person responsible for creative strategy, production and eventually the creative team itself.



How to Apply



Please send:



Examples of Meta ads you have created

Examples of dropshipping products or campaigns you have worked on

At least one Creative Brief you have written, if available

The tools you currently use

A short explanation of how you research competitor ads

A short explanation of how you would create new creatives after the available competitor ads have been exhausted

Explain how you would use different awareness stages when creating ads for the same product

Tell us whether you have previously managed editors or have editors you have successfully worked with before



Please do not send only a general video editing portfolio.



We want to see that you understand the complete process:



Research ? Competitor Ads ? Testing ? Analysis ? Iteration ? Creative Briefs ? Scaling.

title: AI-Enabled Ecommerce Operations Assistant
description:

This is NOT a customer service, sales, cold-calling, or appointment-setting position.



This is a hands-on EXECUTION role.



We have more valuable projects and growth opportunities than our small team currently has time to complete. We need someone who enjoys taking a project, researching what they don't know, using AI and technology intelligently, organizing the information, and getting the work DONE.



Your work will include a variety of projects such as:

We are especially interested in someone who already uses AI creatively for research, ecommerce, content, spreadsheets, organization, documentation, and repetitive workflows.

We care about quality, reliability, communication, attention to detail, and completed results — not whether you are sitting at your computer during a particular U.S. time zone.

HOW TO APPLY

COPPER + CLOUD

title: Executive Assistant to Founder (US Company) — Full-time, Remote
description:
About Us



We're a US-based strategy consultancy. We work with companies on positioning and market strategy, and we also run a paid membership community for professionals in our field. Both are extensions of our founder, which means this role sits close to the center of how the business actually runs, not on its periphery.



A note on discretion: we've kept our company and founder details out of this post on purpose. Our founder has a public profile, and we'd rather run a quiet search than a public one. We'll share who we are in full at the interview stage, and you'll be talking to real people on video well before any commitment is asked of you. Discretion is a core part of this job, so we're starting as we mean to go on.



The Role



We're hiring a strategic partner and right hand to the founder: someone who becomes an extension of how they think, operate, and show up in the world. This isn't a role defined by a fixed task list. It's defined by a standing relationship. You'll be trusted with the judgment calls, instructions, the things that need to happen without being asked twice, ensuring nothing slips through the cracks, and the follow-through that makes their time and attention go further.



Concretely, that means you'll move fluidly across four kinds of responsibility: protecting their time and attention, running the operational backbone of the business, representing their voice externally, and acting as an early-warning system for anything that needs their judgment before it becomes a problem.



The specific tasks will shift week to week. What won't shift is the level of trust, ownership, and proximity to the founder that the role carries.



The Kinds of Responsibility You'll Carry



- Guardian of their time and focus. You'll own the calendar and inbox not as scheduling mechanics, but as an exercise in judgment: knowing what deserves their attention, what can be handled without them, and what needs to be reframed before it reaches them.

- Operator of the business backbone. Payroll, compliance, contracts, vendor relationships, insurance, and account access all run through you. You're the person who makes sure the business doesn't trip over its own administration.

- Extension of their voice. You'll draft and send communications under their name, coordinate their public presence (content, speaking engagements, newsletter), and represent them accurately and well when they're not in the room.

- Partner in the community they've built. Supporting the parts of the membership community that depend on their personal relationships: speaker relationships and high-value member and prospect conversations.

- Trusted with the personal alongside the professional. A limited but real slice of the role touches personal logistics, in coordination with existing household support.



This is deliberately broad. The person who thrives here won't be looking for a checklist. They'll be looking for a role that grows in scope as trust builds, the same way it did for the person who held this seat before you.



You Might Be a Fit If You...



- Have been the right hand to a founder or executive before, and know that the job is really about judgment, not just execution.

- Can hold financial, legal, and personal responsibility (payroll, compliance, account access) with real accuracy and discretion.

- Write well enough that people can't tell where your draft ends and the founder's voice begins.

- Like building the systems and documentation that make a business less dependent on any one person's memory, including your own.

- Want a role that expands with you, not one that stays the same size for three years.



Required



- 3+ years in a senior Executive Assistant, Chief of Staff, or Operations Manager role supporting a founder or executive. Not general VA work.

- Demonstrated ownership of process-heavy administrative work (e.g., payroll, compliance, or similar systems) with high accuracy.

- Strong written English. You'll be drafting and sending communications under someone else's name and voice.

- Track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams independently with minimal supervision.

- Discretion with sensitive financial, legal, and personal information.

- Stable internet and a reliable computer.



Strongly Preferred



- Experience with Gusto or a comparable payroll/HR platform, including US multi-state compliance.

- Comfort with content and media tools (Notion, Slack, basic video and social scheduling tools).

- Experience supporting a public-facing founder, creator, or executive with an active media presence.

- Familiarity with vendor and event logistics.



This role is not for



- Anyone currently holding another full-time job. This is a full-time seat.

- Agencies or teams applying on behalf of staff. We're hiring one person.



Working Style



- Highly organized and process-oriented. Able to build and document systems, not just execute tasks.

- Responsive and available for time-sensitive requests, including some evening and weekend flexibility around events and travel.

- Trustworthy with financial and legal responsibility, and comfortable being the last check before something goes out.



Our Hiring Process



1. Written application (below)

2. Preliminary video interview

3. Final video call with the founder

4. Offer, followed by a full handover period with the current EA before he leaves



How to Apply

Send all four of the items below. Applications missing any part won't be reviewed.



1. Start your message with the word PARTNER so we know you read this post properly.

2. Your resume.

3. A short note (200 to 400 words) on a time you operated as someone's right hand: a system, relationship, or judgment call you owned end to end, and how you made it work. Write it yourself, in your own words. We're reading for how you think and how you write, not for polish.

4. A video of yourself, 2 minutes maximum, answering: why this role, and what part of it are you least experienced in? Please don't script or edit it. We'd rather see you talk normally than watch a rehearsed pitch. A phone camera is completely fine.



We review applications as they come in and will reply to everyone who follows the instructions above.

title: IT Specialist and Senior Developer

title: Real Estate Outbound Caller – U.S. Realtors | Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
# Real Estate Outbound Caller / VA – U.S. Listing Agents



We are a U.S.-based real estate investment company looking for a **part-time outbound caller / Virtual Assistant with the opportunity to grow into a full-time position**.



You will contact real estate agents about residential properties currently listed for sale.



**This is NOT traditional homeowner cold calling.** We provide the property list and listing-agent contact information. You will call professional U.S. real estate agents to determine whether their sellers may be open to an investor purchase or flexible/creative terms.



## Responsibilities



* Make approximately **80–100 outbound calls per day when working full-time**, with proportional targets for part-time hours

* Call U.S. real estate listing agents from lists we provide

* Follow our call script while speaking naturally and professionally

* Ask questions to determine seller motivation and flexibility

* Determine whether the seller may consider:



  * Investor offers

  * Negotiating price

  * Seller financing or flexible terms

  * Other creative purchase structures

* Enter detailed notes after every call into **
**

* Schedule and complete follow-up calls

* Flag interested or potentially motivated sellers for the investor to personally follow up with

* Use our business phone system for calls



**You will NOT negotiate deals or make offers.** Your job is to start the conversation, gather information, and identify opportunities.



## Requirements



* **Excellent spoken English**

* Must be **easily understood by U.S.-based real estate agents**

* Natural, confident, conversational phone manner

* Excellent listening skills

* Comfortable speaking with U.S. Realtors and other professionals

* Previous U.S. outbound calling experience preferred

* U.S. real estate calling experience is a strong plus

* Comfortable with a high volume of outbound calls

* Organized and able to take accurate CRM notes

* Reliable high-speed internet

* Good-quality headset

* Quiet working environment

* Reliable attendance

* Able to work during **U.S. Eastern Time business hours**



## Compensation



**$4–$6 USD/hour**, depending on experience, spoken English, and performance.



**Part-time to start, with the opportunity to grow into a full-time, long-term position for the right person.**



## To Apply



Please send:



1. A brief description of your outbound calling experience

2. Any U.S. real estate calling experience

3. Your current hourly rate

4. Your availability during U.S. Eastern Time

5. How many outbound calls you typically make per hour

6. **A 60-second voice recording** introducing yourself and describing your calling experience



### Please Read Before Applying



To show that you have read the entire job posting:



* Put the word **PHILLY** in the subject line of your application.

* Put a **smiley face ???? immediately after your name** when you sign your application.



**Applications without PHILLY in the subject line, the smiley face after your name, and a voice recording will not be considered.**



We are looking for someone who sounds professional and conversational—not someone who simply reads a script.



If you are reliable, enjoy talking to people, and are good at finding opportunities through conversations, we'd like to hear from you.

title: Amazon Image & Design Specialist, Premium & Heritage Brands
description:
We are an established Amazon agency (20+ years) managing premium and heritage brands in tabletop, glassware, home, and gift. We are hiring an experienced image and design specialist to create and improve listing images, A+ content, and video for these brands.

The core challenge here is different from commodity or private-label work: our products are expensive and often look like generic versions of themselves in a flat photo. A $90 hand-finished ceramic bowl can look identical to a $15 one on screen. The job is making a shopper understand the price difference through the images alone. If your portfolio is mostly text-heavy feature infographics for commodity products, this is not the right role.

What the role involves:



Full image sets: main image, lifestyle and in-context shots, feature and scale callouts, collection cross-sell, and branding and proof images (stamps, gift boxes, made-in, designer, patents, warranty)

A+ content and storefront visuals

Video, including AI-assisted editing of human-shot footage, with correct scale and no artifacts

Researching each brand before designing so the work matches the brand's tone and the real reasons customers buy

Iterating on creative based on performance, customer questions, and competitor benchmarks

Following brand guidelines and license restrictions (some licenses prohibit AI-generated visuals)



Requirements:



Several years of hands-on Amazon image and A+ design with a portfolio you can show

Experience with premium or design-forward products, not just feature callout infographics

Competence with AI image and video tools combined with clear judgment about where they fall short

Familiarity with Amazon image and video technical requirements

ClickUp for tasks and time tracking (we will train you)

Consistent daily hours with some overlap with US Eastern Time



How to apply (applications that skip these steps are not reviewed):



Start your subject line with the word MONTAUK.

Include a portfolio link. Point specifically to one Amazon listing or image set you designed for a premium or higher-priced product and tell me in two or three sentences what you were trying to achieve with it.

Answer these three questions in your own words. Generic or AI-written answers are easy to identify and will not be considered.



a. We sell a $90 hand-finished ceramic serving bowl from a heritage brand. In a flat photo it looks like any other bowl. How do you design the image set so a shopper understands why it is worth far more than a $15 version?



b. How do you use AI image and video tools in your work, and where do they fall short for premium products? Give one specific thing you would not trust AI to handle.



c. You are assigned a brand you have never designed for. What do you do between getting the assignment and starting your first image concepts?

Include your CV.

title: Expert Supply Chain Manager
description:
VogueNow is a growing skincare brand selling across the US, UK, Canada and Europe through Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop and other sales channels. We are looking for an experienced Supply Chain & Inventory Manager to take ownership of our global supply chain—from demand forecasting and purchasing through production, freight, inventory control and final marketplace delivery. Right inventory. Right market. Right time. Right cost and quality.



Key Responsibilities

- Own demand forecasting and inventory planning across Amazon, Shopify, TikTok Shop and other sales channels.

- Maintain healthy inventory levels while reducing stockouts, excess stock, ageing inventory and storage costs.

- Create purchase orders based on forecasts, lead times, safety stock, supplier capacity and cash-flow plans.

- Manage suppliers, production schedules, pricing, quantities, timelines and payment requirements.

Coordinate product inspections and resolve quality issues before inventory is shipped.

- Manage freight from supplier pickup through customs, warehouses, Amazon FBA and final inventory receipt.

- Compare freight options based on cost, speed and operational risk.

Investigate lost, damaged, short-received or incorrectly processed inventory and recover reimbursements.

- Coordinate with Marketing, Product, Finance and Brand Operations on launches, promotions and demand changes.

- Build and improve supply-chain SOPs, trackers, dashboards and automations.

- Provide weekly updates and monthly reporting on inventory health, supplier performance, logistics costs and key risks.



Eligibility Requirements

You must have:

- At least 3 years of professional experience in supply chain, inventory planning, purchasing, logistics or a closely related role.

- Experience managing supply chain for a physical-product or e-commerce business.

- Strong knowledge of forecasting, safety stock, reorder points, lead times and inventory planning.

- Experience managing suppliers, purchase orders, production and international freight.

- Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills.



Who Will Succeed in This Role

- Fast but detail-oriented: You move quickly without creating costly mistakes.

- An owner: You take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

- Proactive: You identify and escalate risks before they become emergencies.

- Highly organised: Your trackers, documents and follow-ups are accurate and updated.

- Resourceful: You find solutions instead of waiting for someone else.

- Systems-minded: You improve processes and automate repetitive work.

- Self-driven: You do not require constant reminders or supervision.

- Committed to improvement: You learn from mistakes and continuously raise your standards.



This Role Is Not for You If

- You only update trackers without analysing or acting on the information.

- You wait for your manager to identify every problem.

- You communicate delays only after deadlines have been missed.

- You need repeated follow-ups to complete agreed actions.

- You avoid accountability or difficult supplier conversations.

- You struggle with details, documentation or follow-through.



How to Apply

- Please submit your CV or profile along with a 3–6 minute video answering the following three questions:

1. Briefly introduce yourself, explain your relevant supply-chain experience and tell us why you are a strong fit for this role.

2. A key product will run out of stock in the US in four weeks. The UK has ten weeks of stock, supplier production is delayed by two weeks, sea freight takes five weeks and air freight costs four times more. A promotion is also planned in six weeks. Explain how you would manage the inventory, freight and promotion while working with limited cash.

3. A supplier informs you that 20% of a completed order has failed inspection three days before shipment. The remaining units are needed for an upcoming launch, and delaying the full shipment may cause a stockout. Explain how you would handle the supplier, inspection failure, shipment decision and internal communication—and what you would put in place to prevent the issue from happening again.



In your written application, please also include:

- Your current location.

- Your availability and notice period.

- Your expected monthly compensation.

- The approximate number of SKUs, suppliers and markets you have managed.

- The supply-chain and inventory tools you have used.

Begin your application with: “RIGHT STOCK, RIGHT TIME”

title: Energy modeling specialist
description:
You are a building energy modeling specialist. You have 3 to 7 years of hands-on experience running full building energy simulations and you know the difference between a well-built model and a model that simply runs. You take modeling seriously and your work product reflects it. 



You are an IES VE expert. IES Virtual Environment is your primary simulation tool. You know it deeply: you can build geometry from scratch, assign constructions, configure HVAC systems, set up occupancy and lighting profiles, run compliance checks, and interpret results. You do not need to be trained on IES VE. 



You know ASHRAE 90.1-2022 inside and out. You have applied both the Energy Cost Budget (ECB) method and the Performance Rating Method (PRM) on real projects. You understand the mandatory requirements, prescriptive path, and how the compliance pathways differ and when each applies. 



You are proficient in the 2024 IECC. You understand the 2024 International Energy Conservation Code commercial provisions including the mandatory requirements, prescriptive compliance path, and Energy Rating Index (ERI) compliance options. You can navigate Section C401 through C408 without looking everything up. 



You understand building systems at a technical level. Envelope assemblies, U-values, SHGC, infiltration rates, HVAC system types and efficiencies, lighting power densities, and plug loads are part of your everyday vocabulary. You know how modeling assumptions affect results. 



You are a strong communicator. You write and speak English at a professional level. You can explain complex energy model results to engineers, architects, and clients in a way that is accurate and understandable. This is a requirement, not a preference. 



You are detail-oriented and self-directed. You catch your own errors before they become client-facing problems. You manage your time, meet deadlines, and produce deliverables that do not require extensive rework. 



 



WHAT YOU WILL DO 



Perform complete building energy simulations using IES VE for new construction, major renovation, and retrofit projects across multiple building types including Healthcare, Mission Critical, Higher Education, and Government facilities. 



Conduct ASHRAE 90.1-2022 compliance modeling using both the Energy Cost Budget (ECB) method and the Performance Rating Method (PRM). Document the baseline building configuration, proposed design, and performance results in accordance with the standard. 



Perform 2024 IECC commercial energy compliance analysis including mandatory requirements review, prescriptive path compliance verification, and trade-off calculations. Produce compliance documentation suitable for submittal to authorities having jurisdiction (AHJ). 



Model all major building systems within IES VE including building envelope assemblies (walls, roofs, floors, fenestration), HVAC systems (air-side and water-side), domestic hot water, lighting systems, plug loads, and on-site renewable energy where applicable. 



Evaluate energy conservation measures (ECMs) through parametric modeling. Run multiple design scenarios, compare results, and provide clear recommendations with supporting data to help clients and design teams make informed decisions. 



Collaborate with commissioning engineers to compare modeled system performance against installed equipment schedules and sequences of operation. Identify discrepancies and support the commissioning process with energy-based analysis. 



Coordinate with project architects and MEP engineers of record to obtain accurate model inputs including construction assemblies, equipment schedules, ventilation rates, and occupancy data. Document all assumptions clearly and maintain an assumption log for each project. 



Prepare clear, professional energy model reports documenting methodology, inputs, results, and conclusions. Reports must be suitable for client delivery and regulatory submittal. 



Support Building Envelope Commissioning (BECx) efforts with thermal bridging analysis, condensation risk review, and energy impact assessment of envelope performance gaps. 



Stay current with code updates, standard revisions, and software developments. As ASHRAE standards and energy codes evolve, you will be expected to adapt modeling practices accordingly. 



 



POSITION REQUIREMENTS 



Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Architectural Engineering, Building Science, or a closely related field (required) 



3 to 7 years of hands-on building energy modeling experience on real construction projects (required) 



Proficiency in IES Virtual Environment (IES VE) is required and nonnegotiable. Candidates who do not have demonstrated IES VE experience will not be considered. 



INTERVIEW REQUIREMENT: All candidates must present a minimum of two completed IES VE energy models during the interview. Candidates will be expected to walk through their modeling approach, explain key assumptions, identify compliance outcomes, and answer detailed technical questions about the models. Presenting borrowed or template models is grounds for immediate disqualification. 



POSITION REQUIREMENTS 

-Demonstrated proficiency in ASHRAE 90.1-2022 including ECB method, PRM compliance pathway, mandatory provisions, and envelope and mechanical system requirements 

-Demonstrated proficiency in 2024 IECC commercial energy provisions including mandatory requirements, prescriptive compliance, and trade-off compliance paths 

-Familiarity with EnergyPlus or DOE-2 simulation engines is a plus 

-Exceptional English proficiency, written and verbal, at a professional business level (required, nonnegotiable) 

-Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Excel, and Outlook 

-Must be available to work hours that overlap with US Central Time (CST) business hours on a consistent, daily basis 

-Full time position, minimum 40 hours per week

title: Real Estate Video Editor — The Media Company
description:
About Us



The Media Company is a real estate media company based in Kingston, Ontario, Canada. We shoot photography, iGuide floor plans, 3D tours, and video for realtors — but video is our flagship. We're known as the best in our market for high-end real estate video, and video is the core of everything we build.



We're growing into a monthly content subscription for realtors — short-form videos that build their personal brand on social media — and we need a skilled editor to help us deliver it at a consistently high standard.



The Role



You'll edit two kinds of content:



Personal brand / social content for realtors: talking-head videos, location showcases, behind-the-scenes clips, and market updates — short-form (60–90 seconds), built for Reels and TikTok.

Listing videos — cinematic property showcases that are the premium product our business is built around.



This isn't a "throw footage together" job. We have a defined style — pacing, colour, music, captions, audio — and you'll be trained on it before touching real client work.



What You'll Do

Edit raw footage into polished, delivery-ready videos following our style bible (pacing, colour grading with provided LUTs, music selection, captioning, purposeful transitions)

Clean, level, and mix audio to a "crispy audio" standard — no hums, hiss, clicks, or wind noise, ever

Cut ruthlessly for hook and pacing — the first 2–3 seconds of every video need to earn attention

Follow our Final Cut Pro workflow standards (project naming, library structure, asset organization)

Submit work through our review process, take feedback from the lead editor, and revise until it hits the bar

Communicate clearly and hit deadlines without needing to be chased

What We're Looking For

Final Cut Pro expertise — this is the one hard requirement. If you primarily edit in Premiere or DaVinci, this isn't the role for you.

Experience editing short-form, social-first content (Reels, TikTok, Shorts)

A strong eye for pacing, colour, and music — someone who can make raw footage feel intentional, not just cut it down

Real estate or personal-brand content experience is a strong plus, but not required if your reel shows the right instincts

Comfortable receiving detailed, specific feedback and iterating quickly

Reliable communicator — someone who flags problems early instead of going quiet

Training & Onboarding



New editors go through a structured 3–4 week onboarding: our style bible, our Final Cut Pro workflow standards, our content formats, a practice edit that has to pass a real quality review, and then supervised work on live client videos before moving to independent work. You'll be trained directly by our lead editor, with final sign-off from our founder.

title: Video editor for AI Ads — Part-time job ($$$)
description:
-----------------------

ABOUT US

-----------------------

You'll be working with a fast-growing beauty brand scaling hard in the French market.

We are an e-commerce brand in the beauty niche. Currently in full expansion, we're strengthening our creative team to keep producing ads that actually convert.

That's why we're looking for a motivated AI Video Editor, ready to get involved in our brand's growth.



-----------------------

YOUR MISSION :

-----------------------

Produce high-volume, AI-generated ad creative that's genuinely comfortable blending into ads that convert — not obviously AI. You should be able to cut confidently across styles: AI UGC, voiceover + b-roll, greenscreen/AI avatar, claymation/Pixar/3D animation, podcast-style, and whatever's winning right now.



-----------------------

What you'll actually need to be good at:

-----------------------

* Hooks & retention editing — you know the first 3 seconds make or break an ad, and how to hold attention with pattern interrupts, zooms, jump cuts and pacing.

* Pacing & rhythm — you cut to the energy of the voiceover/script, tight where it needs to be.

* Storytelling to a script — you build the visual story around a VO/script so the message lands.

* B-roll sourcing & sequencing (incl. AI-generated) — finding or generating the right supporting footage and placing it with purpose.

* Captions & on-screen text — clean, well-timed, on-brand, synced properly.

* Sound design — music selection, audio leveling

* Basic motion graphics & text animation — clean callouts, highlights, transitions.

* Color & cleanup — consistent, polished finish, no jarring cuts or aspect-ratio jumps.

* AI generation — you can actually prompt and produce usable assets (AI UGC clips, claymation, Pixar-style, avatars, b-roll, images) that blend naturally into a real ad.

* Organization — named files, tidy project structure, hitting deadlines.

Tools you should already know: Higgsfield, Seedance, Veo3, Nano Banana Pro — plus CapCut, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Kling, and whatever else is current in the gen-AI stack. This space changes every week; we need someone who keeps up on their own.



-----------------------

What you'll own:

-----------------------

* Consistent daily output of high-quality ad creatives, following our scripts and styles.

* High first-pass approval rate — most submissions should match the brief and be ready to test without revisions.

* Online and responsive during your scheduled hours (part-time, 20h/week).

What matters most beyond the skills:

* DTC/e-commerce experience is a must — show us the work.

* You use AI tools daily and stay updated as new ones drop.

* Mindset: coachable, fast learner, growth-oriented, the type who overdelivers.



-----------------------

COMPENSATION: 

-----------------------

Good pay ($$$), based on skill level and experience, with room to grow as you take on more.



-----------------------

This role is not for you if:

-----------------------

* You make pretty videos but don't understand direct response — if you can't explain why a hook works, this isn't the role.

* You need hand-holding — you'll get guidance, but you're expected to manage your own workload and solve problems without constant check-ins.

* You're a one-tool specialist who resists learning new things.

* You see this as "just a job" — the people who win here are genuinely into short-form AI creative and direct response.

title: Inbound Sales Closer (Full-Time, Permanent) — $1,400 Base + Uncapped Commission | No Cold Calling | Hormozi-Trained US
description:
Same info as below, just nicer: 



START YOUR APPLICATION WITH THE WORD "CLOSER" IN ALL CAPS.

Applications without it are rejected without being read.





THE SHORT VERSION



•  $1,400/month base + 1% of every sale you close. UNCAPPED.

   Realistic earnings once ramped: $2,200–$2,800/month. Top performance: $3,400+.

   There is no ceiling — the commission has no cap and never will.



•  100% warm inbound. Zero cold calling. Zero lead generation.

   Buyers call US with their card in hand and questions a website can't answer.

   Your job: answer them and close.



•  Full-time remote. Monday–Friday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM US Central Time.

   Hiring from Latin America and the Philippines.



•  Trained on Alex Hormozi's sales system. In August 2026, Alex Hormozi and the

   
 team personally advised us at their workshop. Adding YOU is the

   #1 growth move they told us to make — and you'll be onboarded with the

   
 Closer Handbook they gave us.





WHO WE ARE



Merge Screens (
) sells plug-and-play CarPlay / Android Auto

touchscreen upgrades for US pickup trucks — Ford F-150/F-250/F-350, Chevy

Silverado, GMC Sierra, RAM, Toyota Tundra. Customers love the product;

installation is DIY or done by our partner installers.



Our growth: $60k (2021) ? $300k (2022) ? $1M (2023) ? $1.5M (2024) ? $4.5M (2025).

This year we're pushing for 8 figures.



Until today we've sold almost 100% through the website. You will be our FIRST

dedicated closer — the person who turns our phone line into a sales channel.

This is not a support role with sales on the side. It's the sales seat, and

it's empty.





THE MATH — READ THIS BEFORE APPLYING



•  Average order: $1,200–$2,200. With multi-vehicle orders and add-ons: $3,000+.



•  Your daily queue: ~13 inbound pre-purchase calls (hot buyers with questions)

   + ~10 abandoned checkouts with phone numbers (average cart value $1,526).

   Nobody is working these today.



•  You earn 1% of every dollar you close. A typical sale pays $12–$22.

   A multi-screen order with add-ons pays $30–$40+.

   Close 3 sales/day ? about $950/month commission ($2,350 total).

   Close 5/day with strong add-on attach ? $1,800–$2,100 ($3,200–$3,500 total).



•  Proof this is real: our customer-support agent — no sales training, handling

   sales as one-third of his job — earned $450/month in commissions under a

   weaker comp plan. You'll do this full-time, trained, with the whole queue

   to yourself.





WHAT YOU'LL ACTUALLY DO



•  Answer inbound pre-purchase calls and close them live. Calls run 15–20

   minutes: you diagnose (what truck, what problem, how many vehicles), build

   the cart as a Shopify draft order, and either send the checkout link by SMS

   so the customer pays while you're on the phone — or take their card over

   the phone and place the order for them (very common with US buyers).



•  Call abandoned checkouts the same day and recover them.



•  Open every call the way Hormozi taught us: "How many vehicles did you want

   screens for?" Most US households own 2+ vehicles — multi-unit selling is

   the norm here, not a stretch.



•  Attach add-ons customers genuinely want: wireless upgrade bundles, extended

   warranty, cameras. This is where good closers separate from average ones.



•  Build your own follow-up system for the "let me check with my wife" calls.

   We give you the tools (JustCall, SMS, company
); the discipline and

   the system are yours to build and own.



•  Feed what you hear back to us. Your calls are free R&D for our FAQ, product

   pages and ads — you'll have a direct line to the founders.





WHERE THIS GOES



We're following a plan to take this company to $10M+ with phone sales and

advertising scaling as core channels. When call volume doubles, we hire

closer #2 — and the first closer who performs becomes the obvious pick to

lead the team. You'd be employee-one of a sales org, not a seat in one.





YOU ARE



•  Experienced: 2+ years closing B2C sales on the phone — high-volume,

   transactional (15–30 min cycles, not enterprise deals).



•  A near-native English speaker with a neutral accent. Our buyers are

   American truck owners.



•  Fluent in your own numbers: you know your close rate, average ticket and

   calls/day from your last role, and you can back them up.



•  Autonomous: you don't wait to be managed. You see the queue, you work the

   queue, you build the system that squeezes more out of it.



•  A student of the craft: ready to master our scripts and the 150-page

   
 Closer Handbook in your first two weeks.



•  Set up to work: quiet space, headset, reliable fiber internet, backup

   power/internet if your area needs it.





COMPENSATION & TERMS



•  $1,400/month base + 1% uncapped commission on sales you close live on the

   phone (customer pays during your call via draft-order checkout link or card).



•  15 paid vacation days per year.



•  Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM US Central (10-hour shift,

   includes 1 hour of paid breaks: a 30-min meal plus short breaks, scheduled

   around the slow windows). The queue is live all day — the longer you're on

   the phones, the more you close.



•  Paid monthly in USD. Independent contractor. Long-term role — we're

   building a team, not filling a gig.



•  Hiring process: screening questions ? 20-min culture interview ? a final

   interview where you prove your sales skills live. We move fast — days,

   not weeks.





HOW TO APPLY



1. Start your application with the word CLOSER (all caps), followed by a

   max-150-word introduction.



2. Record a 60–90 second voice note (Vocaroo, Loom or similar — paste the

   link) answering this live, as if the customer were on the phone:



   "I love the screen, but I'm not sure it fits my 2019 F-150 — and honestly,

   $1,300 feels steep."



3. Answer the screening questions.





SCREENING QUESTIONS

 

1. YOUR NUMBERS. In your last phone sales role: what did you sell, what was

   the average ticket, your close rate, and your calls per day? How could we

   verify these numbers if we asked?

 

2. FOLLOW-UP. A hot caller says "I need to check with my wife" and hangs up.

   Describe your EXACT follow-up over the next 7 days: how many touches,

   which channels, what timing, and roughly what each message says.

 

3. UPSELL. A customer is buying one $1,299 screen for his F-150. Walk us

   through, in your words, how you'd turn this into a bigger order without

   being pushy.

 

4. LOGISTICS. Confirm you can work Monday–Friday, 10:30 AM – 8:30 PM US

   Central Time. What city are you in, what is that window in your local

   time, and what's your earliest start date?

 

5. MONEY. Based on the numbers in this post (daily queue, order values, the

   1% commission), what do you realistically expect to be earning here by

   month 3 — base plus commission? Show your math.

title: Hiring: Advanced Video Editor — Long-Form YouTube Essays, Reels, Podcast
description:
About the role



We run a YouTube channel, two instagram pages, and a membership community. We're looking for an editor with real video editing and animation skills, plus the ability to own content editing from raw footage -> long form polished edit -> short form edits and repurposing content as needed. 



This is an ongoing, recurring role (per-video or weekly, negotiable) covering the full pipeline: long-form YouTube essays (30–40 min), podcast uploads (just the audio file from the long form content videos), thumbnails, and short-form Reels cut from the long-form material.



Technical requirements



- Dynamic masking & layering: Rotoscope/masking the subject(s) to composite them in front things onscreen

- Comfortable with keyframed mask tracking across moving subjects, not just static crops.

- Pattern interruptions / cutting rhythm: Break up static talking-head footage every few seconds using punch-in zooms, meme splices, and GIF cutaways — timed to beats in the VO, not randomly dropped in.

- Understand pacing well enough to combat attention drop-off across a 30–40 minute runtime without making the edit feel frantic of overdone

- Textual overlays / kinetic typography: Syncing quote cards, text, research citations, etc. over the footage according the the VO

- J-cuts & L-cuts

- color grading

- 2d onscreen stop motion animation 

- Multimedia intercutting: intercut archival footage, stock clips, screen recordings, still images, and audio clips within a single sequence — multi-track compositing, not just A/B-roll switching.

- Basic video editing skills, of course





Plus Additional pipeline responsibilities:



- Long-form YouTube editing (using the skills above)

- Short form content editing (reels; using the skills above)

- Repurposing long form content into short form reels

- Content sourcing: Source appropriate footage, imagery, film clips, and reference material (YouTube, Pinterest, archive sites, etc.) that the masking and intercutting techniques above depend on.

- Creating YouTube thumbnails

- Creating Reel covers

- Exporting mp3 files of long form content



Tools/Skills

- A real NLE with compositing capability — Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or After Effects (masking/roto and multi-track work isn't feasible in a transcript-based editor alone; Descript may be used for the initial assembly/transcript-based cut, but final compositing needs a proper timeline tool).

- A thumbnail/graphics tool (Photoshop, Canva, etc.)

- Comfortable sourcing and downloading reference footage/images from YouTube, Pinterest, and archival sources.

- Familiarity with uploading/publishing to YouTube and a podcast host.

- Excellent English proficiency



What I'm looking for in you

- Real command of masking/keying, keyframed text, split edits, and multi-track compositing — not template-based or AI-slop-auto-edit work.

- Can own the full pipeline: raw footage ? composited long-form edit ? thumbnail ? published YouTube video ? podcast upload ? repurposed Reels.

- Strong pacing instincts for long-form (30–40 min) content — know how to keep attention without making the edit feel chaotic.

- Comfortable doing your own research/sourcing for the footage and imagery your composites depend on.

- Precise with instructions like "cut whole sentences only"

- Unique and creative artistic taste and eye. We are not looking for content that looks like everyone else's. 



To apply:

Send a reel or examples showing masking/compositing work (subject placed into archival footage or scenes), J-cut/L-cut usage in a long-form piece, and text/citation overlay work.



please note: generic "talking head" video edit submissions will not be considered.

We're an e-commerce and education group that ships product visuals daily, and we're looking for an experienced "superstar" graphic designer who works the modern way: not one prompt at a time, but building repeatable node-based AI pipelines that turn concepts into polished, production-ready graphics at scale. If you already think in nodes, blocks, and workflows, you'll feel right at home.



***EXPERIENCE NEEDED for this position***

We are looking only for designers with real experience and a portfolio to show. If you don't have prior experience, please do not apply. We value people who work independently, take initiative, and deliver quality work with minimal supervision.



Job Scope:

- Conceptualizing visuals based on requirements

- Developing product graphics from scratch

- Bringing visual improvements to existing products using your artistic talent

- Creating images and lifestyle visuals using design software and Photoshop

- Building and maintaining node-based AI pipelines in Weavy (Weave) and/or Magnific AI, connecting prompt, image, video, and upscaler blocks into repeatable, automated workflows

- Upscaling and enhancing imagery to crisp, production-grade quality

- Testing graphics across various media platforms



Requirements:

- Proven graphic design experience with a strong portfolio of illustrations or other graphics

- Hands-on experience building node-based AI workflows (Weavy, Magnific AI, ComfyUI, or similar node canvases)

- Familiarity with design software (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop)

- A keen eye for aesthetics and detail

- Excellent communication skills

- Ability to work methodically and meet deadlines

- Degree in Design, Fine Arts, or a related field is a plus



Note:

- Full-time basis - 40 hrs/week (Monday to Friday)

- Working hours: 10am to 6:30pm (30 min lunch break)

- 14 days of Paid Annual Leave and Paid Public Holidays Benefits (all major holidays in the Philippines) included



IMPORTANT: When applying, please provide:

- Your CV/Resume

- A short video introduction of yourself and why you think you're a good fit

- Why you are leaving your last job or what you were doing just before this application

- Reference links to your graphic design portfolio (Behance, Drive, Dropbox, etc.) AND examples of node-based AI workflows you have built (screenshots of your Weavy / Magnific / ComfyUI pipelines are welcome). If you have used comparable tools rather than these specific ones, please show them and say so



Applications that do not follow the above instructions will not be entertained. Applications with video introductions will be prioritized.



P.S. Please format your replies in point form according to the items asked above, e.g.:

My resume is here:

Video introduction here:

I am currently doing... / I am leaving because...

Here are examples of my work and workflows...



The more information you provide in your initial application, the better.



Best regards,

Loo Yi

- The solution you designed and implemented

title: Short Form Video Editor
description:
About This Role

-We don’t need someone who can “edit videos.”

-We need someone who understands attention.



If you know how to hook in the first 2 seconds, control pacing, build tension with captions, and turn raw footage into content people actually finish watching — keep reading.



You’ll be responsible for creating high-impact vertical content designed to stop the scroll, increase retention, and drive measurable engagement across TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.



What You’ll Be Responsible For:

-Editing 15–60 second vertical videos optimized for performance

-Crafting powerful hooks that immediately grab attention

-Adding dynamic captions, motion graphics, sound effects, and transitions

-Repurposing long-form content into high-retention short clips

-Staying ahead of trends, viral formats, and platform behaviors

-Collaborating with marketing and content teams to align on brand voice

-Testing different hooks, pacing styles, and caption formats to improve metrics

-1–3+ years editing short-form content specifically

-Experience working with influencers or personal brands

-Motion graphics experience (After Effects is a plus)

What Success Looks Like

-Higher engagement rates

-Consistent, on-brand output

-Content that aligns with current platform behavior and trends

Why Join Us

title: Mirakl Marketplace Specialist (MediaMarkt marketplace)
description:

That's why we're hiring you: you take the entire Mirakl setup off our hands, from shop creation to approved listings.



After the setup you stay on as our go-to Mirakl person for new products and new markets, paid per task.



The Job



Full ownership of our MediaMarkt/Mirakl setup. You are the expert — we won't micromanage you, you tell us what you need:

• Complete the shop setup in Mirakl (settings, shipping, returns)

• Create all product listings and offers following the MediaMarkt content guidelines

 — you copy and adapt it to the Mirakl format (no content writing from scratch)

 listings — we will not supply all assets per product

• Report progress to us in short updates.

Markets

 listings)

• Later (likely): MediaMarkt Germany (German content)



After Go-Live



Once everything is live, the big work is done. After that you could be our on-call Mirakl contact:

• Adding new products when we launch them

• Expanding to new Mirakl marketplaces (MediaMarkt DE and possibly others)

• Fixing content/offer issues when they come up

This is occasional work, paid per task or per hour — perfect as a side engagement next to other clients.

Requirements

• Proven experience with Mirakl-based marketplaces - this is mandatory

• Experience with marketplace product content: EANs, attributes, category mapping, bulk uploads (Excel/CSV)

• Extreme attention to detail - you will work with Dutch product texts; you don't need to speak Dutch, but nothing may get lost or broken when copying

• Self-managing: you figure things out via Mirakl Help and the MediaMarkt content team, not by asking us

Compensation

• Setup project: one-time fee based on hours worked. Give us your hourly rate and your estimate of total hours in your application

• After go
 per-task or hourly, whenever we need you

To Apply, send us:

1. Proof of Mirakl experience: (for example by adding screenshots or shop names of Mirakl marketplaces you've worked on) — mandatory, applications without this will not be reviewed

2. Your hourly rate + estimated hours to get ±50 products live on a new Mirakl shop
