title: E-commerce Customer Support Specialist
description:
About Us



We are a fast-growing European e-commerce company specializing in premium travel products. Every day, we help thousands of customers across multiple countries and are committed to delivering an outstanding customer experience before, during and after every purchase.



We are looking for a reliable, proactive and customer-focused Customer Service & Review Management Specialist who enjoys helping people, solving problems and taking ownership of customer satisfaction. This is a long-term position for someone who wants to grow with our company and become an important part of our team.



Your Responsibilities



Customer Service



As our Customer Service Specialist, you will be the first point of contact for our customers. Your goal is to provide fast, professional and solution-oriented support while ensuring every customer has a positive experience.



Your daily responsibilities include:



- Answer customer inquiries professionally and efficiently via
, WhatsApp and other communication channels

- Provide friendly, accurate and solution-oriented support to every customer

- Handle questions regarding orders, deliveries, products, returns and exchanges

- Process warranty claims and damaged product cases according to our company policies

- Keep track of ongoing repair cases and follow up with customers when necessary

- Arrange replacement parts such as wheels, handles, locks and other spare parts

- Create and manage return labels and shipping documentation

- Follow up on delayed, missing or lost shipments with customers and shipping carriers

- Keep all customer cases organized and up to date in Excel spreadsheets and our internal systems

- Maintain accurate records of all customer interactions and after-sales cases

- Report recurring customer issues, product feedback and operational updates to management

- Escalate complex cases to management when necessary while providing all relevant information

- Continuously look for ways to improve customer satisfaction and internal processes



Review Management



You will also play an important role in protecting and improving our online reputation.



Your responsibilities include:



- Monitor customer reviews across platforms such as Trustpilot, Google, Amazon, 
 and other marketplaces

- Respond professionally and empathetically to both positive and negative customer reviews

- Investigate negative reviews by reviewing order history and previous customer communication

- Contact customers when a review relates to an unresolved issue and work towards an appropriate solution

- Follow up with customers until their issue has been successfully resolved

- Politely ask satisfied customers whether they would consider updating or reconsidering their review after a successful resolution

- Identify recurring complaints, customer feedback and product issues

- Prepare reports with customer insights, trends and recommendations for management

- Help maintain a strong online reputation and high customer satisfaction ratings



What We Are Looking For



We are looking for someone who genuinely enjoys helping customers and takes pride in delivering excellent service. You are organized, professional, calm under pressure and able to make sound decisions independently.



Requirements



- Excellent written and spoken English

- Outstanding communication and interpersonal skills

- Previous experience in customer service, after-sales support or e-commerce

- Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

- Friendly, professional and customer-focused communication style

- Highly organized with excellent attention to detail

- Able to work independently with minimal supervision

- Comfortable working with Excel, Google Sheets and online business systems

- Able to manage multiple customer cases simultaneously while maintaining high quality

- Able to remain calm and professional when dealing with frustrated customers

- Willing to learn our products, warranty policies and internal procedures

- Reliable internet connection and a quiet workspace suitable for remote work



Education

 

We value education and professional development.



Please include the following with your application:



- Your CV or Resume

- A copy of your diploma(s), degree(s) or relevant certificate(s)

- A short introduction about yourself

- Your expected monthly salary

- Your earliest available start date



What We Offer



- Full-time remote position

- Long-term employment opportunity

- A supportive and growing international team

- Opportunity to take ownership and make an impact

- Training on our products, systems and internal processes

- Opportunities for professional growth and career development



We are looking for someone who wants to build a long-term career with us, take ownership of customer service and help us deliver an exceptional customer experience every single day.



If you believe you are the right fit for this position, we look forward to receiving your application.

title: US Tax Professional — IRS Enrolled Agent
description:
# U.S. Enrolled Agent — Offshore Tax Resolution Specialist



---



POSITION OVERVIEW



We are seeking a highly capable U.S. Enrolled Agent (EA) based in the Philippines to support U.S. federal tax resolution, tax compliance, and IRS representation matters.



This role is intended for a professional who can do more than prepare returns. The ideal candidate understands IRS procedure, can analyze taxpayer records and transcripts, communicate effectively with the IRS, and independently move tax-resolution cases toward resolution.



This is a full-time remote position supporting a U.S.-based tax resolution operation.



---



KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



```

      - Represent taxpayers before the IRS within the scope permitted to Enrolled Agents



      - Prepare and manage IRS Power of Attorney filings, including Form 2848



      - Contact the IRS Practitioner Priority Service and other IRS departments on behalf of clients



      - Obtain, review, and analyze:



                - Account transcripts



                - Wage and Income transcripts



                - Tax Return transcripts



                - Record of Account transcripts



                - Collection history and account activity



      - Identify outstanding tax filings, balances, penalties, compliance issues, and collection risks



      - Develop recommended resolution strategies based on each client's financial and tax situation



      - Assist with or independently manage:



                - Installment Agreements



                - Currently Not Collectible status



                - Offers in Compromise



                - Penalty Abatement



                - Collection Due Process matters



                - IRS notices and correspondence



                - Levy and lien matters



                - Revenue Officer cases



                - IRS examination and audit support



      - Prepare financial analysis and supporting documentation for Forms 433-A, 433-B, 433-F, and related collection forms



      - Review client financial documents, including bank statements, income records, expenses, assets, liabilities, and business financials



      - Determine IRS allowable expenses and reasonable collection potential where applicable



      - Track case deadlines, IRS correspondence, follow-ups, and required client documentation



      - Maintain detailed case notes and documentation within the company's CRM and case-management systems



      - Communicate case status and required actions clearly to internal staff and, where assigned, directly to clients



      - Work with tax preparers, case managers, sales personnel, and management to ensure cases progress efficiently



      - Escalate complex or high-risk matters when appropriate



      - Maintain strict confidentiality and comply with applicable U.S. tax-information security requirements

```



---



REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS



```

      - Active IRS Enrolled Agent credential



      - Experience working with U.S. individual and/or business taxation



      - Practical familiarity with IRS tax-resolution and collection procedures



      - Experience reading and interpreting IRS transcripts



      - Strong understanding of federal tax compliance requirements



      - Comfortable communicating directly with IRS representatives



      - Excellent written and spoken English



      - Strong attention to detail and case documentation



      - Ability to manage multiple active cases and deadlines simultaneously



      - Reliable computer, internet connection, and professional remote-work environment



      - Ability to work hours that overlap substantially with U.S. business hours

```



---



PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS



```

      - 2+ years of U.S. tax-resolution experience



      - Experience working for a U.S. tax-resolution firm, CPA firm, EA firm, or tax law practice



      - Experience handling IRS Collections cases from intake through resolution



      - Experience with Forms 433-A, 433-B, 433-F, 656, 9465, 843, and related IRS forms



      - Experience preparing or reviewing Forms 1040, 1065, 1120, and 1120-S



      - Familiarity with tax software, IRS transcript systems, CRM platforms, and document-management systems



      - Experience communicating directly with U.S. clients



      - Experience working remotely for a U.S.-based organization

```



---



IDEAL CANDIDATE



The strongest candidate is someone who can be given a taxpayer's file, obtain the appropriate authorization and transcripts, determine what is happening with the account, identify available resolution options, communicate with the IRS, document the case properly, and continue following the matter until the next required action or resolution.



We are specifically looking for real-world capability rather than credentials alone. An EA designation is required, but demonstrated experience, judgment, organization, and ability to independently manage tax-resolution work are equally important.



---



COMPENSATION



```

      - USD $1,000–$2,000 per month



      - Compensation will depend on experience and demonstrated ability



      - Higher compensation reserved for candidates with substantial tax-resolution experience



      - Performance-based bonuses may be available based on productivity, quality, reliability, and case-management capability

```



---



SCHEDULE



```

      - Full-time



      - Remote



      - Philippines-based



      - Schedule must provide meaningful overlap with U.S. business hours



      - Exact working hours will be established based on operational requirements

```



---



PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS



```

      - Case accuracy and quality



      - Timely IRS follow-up



      - Proper documentation and case notes



      - Ability to meet deadlines



      - Case progression and resolution



      - Professional IRS and client communication



      - Productivity and caseload management



      - Minimal preventable errors



      - Reliability and responsiveness

```



---



APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS



```

      - Resume



      - Current IRS Enrolled Agent status



      - Years of U.S. tax experience



      - Years of direct tax-resolution experience



      - Types of IRS cases personally handled



      - Experience with Forms 433-A, 433-B, 433-F, and 656



      - Experience handling IRS calls and negotiations



      - Experience preparing U.S. tax returns



      - Current or most recent monthly compensation



      - Expected monthly compensation in USD



      - Availability to begin work

```



---

and

Proven experience in SEO and content marketing

Excellent written English

About the role



I run a performance nutrition coaching business and I appear on podcasts regularly. I need someone to turn those long podcast recordings into short, punchy Instagram Reels.



The good news for you is that I hand you everything worked out in advance. The clip timestamps, the exact words being said, the on-screen hook text and notes on which b-roll to use and where. Your job is to cut it clean, make it vertical, caption it well and layer my own footage over the top so it looks professional and on-brand.



This is a one-off project to start, around 30 clips from recent episodes. If it goes well there is potential for more work down the line, as I record new podcasts fairly regularly, so I would love to find someone I can come back to.



What you will be doing



- Cutting short clips, roughly 30 to 60 seconds, from long podcast videos using the timestamps I give you

- Reframing to vertical 9:16 with speaker tracking so I stay in frame

- Adding clean, well-timed animated captions

- Adding the on-screen hook text for the first few seconds

- Layering my own b-roll over the talking head at the points I mark, from folders I share with you

- Light background music and tidy audio, then exporting ready to post



What I will give you



- The podcast video files

- A detailed brief for every clip: the timestamp, a transcript of the exact section, the hook text and notes on which b-roll to use

- Access to my B-roll folder and my race footage folders

- A style reference once we lock the look on the first few clips



What I need from you



- Solid short-form editing experience, ideally with fitness, sport or talking-head content

- Confident with captions and vertical reframing in CapCut, Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve

- A good eye for pace, and for where a clip should start and end

- Reliable communication and able to hit small agreed deadlines

- You only use the footage I provide. No stock footage and no generated graphics



Delivery

- Upload the finished clips to a shared Google Drive folder I will give you

- Export vertical 9:16, high quality, one file per clip, named to match the brief so I can find them easily, for example "Clip 03 nutrition is all grey"

- I handle all posting and the written post captions myself, so those are not your job. Your work is done once the edited clip is in the Drive folder

- To be clear, the animated captions on the video itself (the subtitles of what I am saying) are your job. It is only the written post caption and the posting I take care of



Hours and volume

- This is a one-off project of around 30 clips

- I would like the first 3 to 5 clips within the first week, so we can lock the style before you build the rest

- The full batch delivered within 2 to 3 weeks of starting, in weekly batches

- Potential for more work in future if it goes well, but no obligation on either side

- Flexible on when you work, as long as we agree deadlines and you hit them



How to apply

- Send me two or three examples of short-form vertical clips you have edited, ideally talking-head or fitness content

- Tell me which editing software you use

- Start your message with the word FUEL so I know you actually read this



Rate

- 6-8USD per finished clip, which is around 240 US dollars for the full batch of about 30. Paid in batches as clips are delivered and approved.

title: SEO Specialist for Danish Local Business Websites
description:
Long-Term SEO Specialist for Danish Business Clients



I run a Danish web agency that creates and improves websites for small and medium-sized businesses. I am now looking for a reliable SEO specialist for a potentially long-term working relationship.



The first client is Nordkyst Biler, a Danish used-car dealership located in Ishøj:







The objective is to improve the website’s technical SEO, local visibility and organic traffic from people interested in buying or selling a used car.



Hours and workload



There will be more work during the first month because the website requires an initial SEO setup.



Expected workload:



* First month: approximately 7-8 approved hours

* Following months: approximately 3–5 approved hours per month

* All hours must be agreed upon before work begins

* Additional work is always approved and paid separately



This is not a full-time position. It is a small monthly assignment that can grow as my agency gains more clients.



Monthly payment structure



The client pays my agency a monthly fee for SEO. I then use part of that payment to pay you for the approved SEO work.



You will be paid once per month for all approved and completed hours. Monthly work will only be scheduled after the client’s payment and SEO budget have been confirmed. You will always know the approved number of hours before beginning the work.



Please do not exceed the approved monthly hours without receiving permission first.



First-month responsibilities



The first month should establish a strong SEO foundation. The work should include:



* A technical, local and on-page SEO audit

* Danish keyword research

* Focus on relevant searches related to used cars, car dealerships and selling a car in Ishøj, Vestegnen and the Copenhagen area

* A keyword-to-page plan

* Optimization of the homepage and “Sell Your Car” page

* Improved page titles, meta descriptions, headings and internal links

* Review of indexing, XML sitemap, robots.txt and canonical URLs

* Ensuring login and irrelevant pages are not indexed

* Review of how sold or removed vehicles are handled

* Review of the dynamically generated vehicle pages

* Recommendations for scalable SEO templates for current and future vehicles

* Appropriate LocalBusiness and vehicle/product structured data

* Setup or review of Google Search Console and Google Analytics

* Review and optimization of the company’s Google Business Profile

* A short report showing completed work and recommended next steps



Ongoing monthly responsibilities



After the initial setup, the monthly workload will be smaller and focused on the highest-priority improvements.



The ongoing work may include:



* Reviewing Google Search Console

* Monitoring organic clicks, rankings and enquiries

* Checking that new vehicle listings are indexed correctly

* Checking that sold vehicles are handled correctly

* Completing one prioritized SEO improvement each month

* Fixing smaller technical SEO issues

* Improving Google Business Profile

* Providing a short monthly report and time log



Opportunities for additional paid work



The basic SEO agreement only includes a limited number of monthly hours.



Some clients may choose a more extensive SEO package. For Nordkyst Biler, this could include individually optimizing every vehicle listing with unique titles, descriptions, keywords, structured data and internal links.



If the client chooses this additional service, more hours will be approved and your payment will increase accordingly. This deeper work is not expected to be completed within the basic monthly hours.



I also expect my agency to gain additional clients. If you perform well, communicate clearly and deliver useful results for Nordkyst Biler, you will be my preferred SEO specialist for future client websites.



Each additional client will have a separate scope, number of hours and payment. Future work cannot be guaranteed, but I am looking for someone who can grow with the agency over time.



Requirements



* At least two years of practical SEO experience

* Strong technical, on-page and local SEO knowledge

* Experience with dynamic, inventory, e-commerce or automotive websites is preferred

* Experience with Google Search Console and GA4

* Experience with crawling and keyword research tools

* Ability to prioritize work within a limited monthly budget

* Good written English

* Clear communication and reliable time reporting

* Ability to explain exactly what was changed and why



You do not need to speak Danish fluently. However, you must be able to research Danish keywords and search intent carefully. All customer-facing Danish text will be reviewed before publication.



We only want ethical and sustainable SEO. Do not purchase backlinks, use private blog networks, create spam links or make major changes without approval.



How to apply



Start your application with the word “NORDKYST” so I know you have read the complete description.



Please answer the following:



1. What are three specific SEO issues or opportunities you notice on nordkystbiler.dk?

2. What would you prioritize during the first 7-8 hours?

3. How would you use only 3–5 hours effectively in the following months?

4. Do you have experience with local businesses, automotive websites or dynamic product listings?

5. Which SEO tools do you use?

6. What is your hourly rate?

7. Are you comfortable with varying hours and monthly payment?



Please include one relevant example or case study. Generic applications that do not mention the website will not be considered.

title: Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller
description:
Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller

Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time 

Experience Required: 1–2 Years



Turn Your Voice Into Your Biggest Asset



Are you the person who can get a "no" and still walk away with a callback? Do you thrive on the thrill of a great pitch and love closing the gap between a cold lead and a booked appointment? We're looking for a Commercial Real Estate Cold Caller who's ready to bring energy, persistence, and persuasion to a growing, fast-paced commercial real estate team.

This isn't just dialing numbers — it's the front line of our acquisitions pipeline for commercial properties, including office, retail, industrial, multifamily (5+ units), and mixed-use assets. Every call you make has the potential to turn into a deal, and every deal you help set up is a direct reflection of your skill on the phone. Commercial deals move differently than residential — longer relationships, bigger stakes, and owners or decision-makers who expect a caller who sounds like they know the space.

If you're confident, quick on your feet, and genuinely enjoy the game of turning "not interested" into "let's talk," we want to hear from you.



What You'll Do



Make outbound cold calls to commercial property owners, landlords, investors, asset managers, and brokers across asset classes (office, retail, industrial, multifamily, mixed-use)

Pull and build targeted call lists using county records, CRE data platforms, and public/private property databases

Identify and qualify off-market and undervalued commercial properties based on owner motivation, property condition, and financial indicators

Gather key property details: lease type (NNN, gross, modified gross), tenant occupancy/vacancy status, square footage, zoning, and ownership structure

Research and reach decision-makers directly — including owners, property managers, LLC representatives, and asset managers — not just front-desk contacts

Set qualified appointments for our acquisitions/sales team with clear notes on deal potential

Maintain and update CRM with detailed call notes, property data, and lead status

Follow call scripts while keeping conversations natural, credible, and tailored to commercial owners

Hit daily/weekly call volume, talk-time, and lead generation targets

Handle objections with confidence — especially from sophisticated owners, brokers, and gatekeepers who are used to fielding investor calls



What You Bring



1–2 years of experience in a call center handling international accounts, and/or real estate cold calling — commercial experience strongly preferred

Excellent English communication skills (neutral accent preferred)

Comfort speaking with business owners, investors, and brokers — not just residential homeowners

Strong persuasion and negotiation instincts — you know how to read a conversation and steer it

Ability to work independently and stay motivated with minimal supervision

Comfort with high-volume outbound calling and skip tracing/contact research

Experience pulling and building your own lead lists (county records, CRE data platforms, or similar tools)

A target-driven mindset and genuine competitive streak

Familiarity with CRM systems (a plus, not a must)



Bonus Points For



Working knowledge of commercial real estate terminology: cap rate, NOI, NNN/gross leases, cash-on-cash return, CRE asset classes

Experience cold calling for office, retail, industrial, or multifamily acquisitions specifically

Experience with lead generation tools, skip tracing platforms, and auto-dialers

Familiarity with list-pulling/data platforms such as PropStream, Reonomy, CoStar, or county assessor records

Prior appointment-setting experience for acquisitions or investment sales teams

Sharp listening skills and objection-handling instincts with sophisticated, high-value prospects



Why You'll Want This Role



Competitive base salary — get rewarded for showing up and doing the work

Performance-based incentives/bonuses — the better you perform, the more you earn

Real growth opportunities — this is a growing company, and top performers won't go unnoticed

A supportive, performance-driven team — we win together, and we celebrate wins



Ready to Make Your Calls Count?



Send your updated resume and a short recording (Loom or Vocaroo — link only)

Walmart WFS Online Arbitrage Sourcing VA (Part-Time / Trial-to-Hire)

Type: Part-time, remote, hourly

Hours: 15–20 hrs/week to start (room to grow for the right person)

Rate: $3–6/hr, based on experience

Start: Immediate, paid trial week first

About the role

I run a Walmart Marketplace business using Walmart Fulfillment Services (WFS). I need a reliable, detail-oriented Online Arbitrage (OA) sourcing specialist to find profitable products daily, using tools like Tactical Arbitrage, SellerAmp, or similar, and hand me a clean, vetted list of leads I can approve for purchase.

This is not a general VA role (no
 management, no customer service). It is a focused, repeatable sourcing job. If you’re good at it, this can become a long-term, growing weekly commitment.

What you’ll do

 • Run daily/weekly scans across major retailers (Target, Home Depot, Lowe’s, BJ’s, Macy’s, etc.) against the Walmart catalog using bulk scanning tools

 • Vet each lead against my deal criteria (ROI, sell-through, competition, brand risk — details provided in onboarding)

 • Check for IP/brand restrictions, gated categories, and Buy Box ownership before including a lead

 • Log qualified leads in a shared Google Sheet with source link, cost, Walmart price, fees, ROI%, and notes

 • Flag any product with antimicrobial/hazmat/battery claims or other compliance risk for my review

 • Focus primarily on Home & Kitchen, Baby Products, Toys & Games, Sports & Outdoors, and Automotive accessories categories

 • Provide a short daily or end-of-week summary of leads found

Requirements

 • Prior experience with online arbitrage sourcing for Amazon and/or Walmart specifically (Walmart experience is a strong plus, not a dealbreaker)

 • Working knowledge of at least one bulk scanning tool (Tactical Arbitrage, ArbiSource, Arbitrage Hero) and/or SellerAmp

 • Comfortable calculating ROI, sell-through estimates, and fee structures independently

 • Strong written English for clear lead notes and daily summaries

 • Reliable internet connection and consistent availability during agreed hours

 • Detail-oriented — I’d rather have 5 great leads than 30 mediocre ones

Nice to have

 • Experience with SellerAmp WAMP (Walmart-specific module, new in 2026)

 • Familiarity with Walmart’s Seller Analytics dashboard / Assortment Growth tool

 • Experience with Keepa or similar for cross-checking demand trends

How to apply

Please include:

 1. Your OA sourcing experience (Amazon, Walmart, or both — specify)

 2. Which tools you’ve used and how long

 3. Your typical ROI and sell-through targets when sourcing

 Daylight Time).

Required Skills & Competencies:

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong organizational and time management skills.

• Customer-focused mindset with the ability to build positive relationships.

• Basic accounting and financial knowledge.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Quickbooks Online

• Ability to maintain confidentiality with sensitive financial information.

• Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.



Preferred Experience:

title: LMS / E-Learning Website Developer – Build a Professional Online Training Academy
description:
About the Project



The National Association of Marine Vessel Surveyors (NAMVS) is developing a professional online training and certification platform at 
 for individuals pursuing careers and continuing education in marine vessel surveying.



We are currently working with an Instructional Design & E-Learning Development Specialist who will develop the curriculum, course structure, learning materials, presentations, assessments, and training content.



We are now looking for an experienced LMS Website Developer / Full-Stack E-Learning Developer to build the technology platform that will house and deliver these courses.



This is not a basic website project. Our goal is to develop a polished, professional online learning academy that can compete with established online schools and certification programs.



Responsibilities



You will be responsible for designing, developing, configuring, and launching the NAMVS online learning platform, including:



Develop a modern, professional and highly polished LMS website

Create secure student registration and login systems

Build individual student dashboards

Upload and organize video-based training courses and lessons

Create course modules, chapters, quizzes, exams and assessments

Track student course progress and completion

Restrict advancement until required lessons or examinations are completed

Develop automated certificates of completion/certification

Allow students to download or verify certificates

Create secure paid access to courses

Integrate online checkout and payment processing

Allow students to purchase individual courses or course packages

Automatically provide course access following payment

Protect paid course content from unauthorized users

Integrate video hosting/streaming into the training platform

Develop an administrative dashboard for managing students, courses and enrollments

Create automated
s for registration, payment, course completion and certification

Provide reporting on enrollment, progress, completion and student activity

Ensure the platform works exceptionally well on desktop, tablet and mobile devices

Build the system so additional courses and certifications can easily be added in the future

Ensure website security, backups, performance and scalability

Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone with strong experience developing professional LMS and online education platforms.



Experience should include several of the following:



Learning Management Systems (LMS)

WordPress / LearnDash / Tutor LMS / LifterLMS or similar platforms

Custom LMS development

Full-stack website development

Membership and subscription websites

Stripe and/or PayPal payment integration

WooCommerce or similar e-commerce systems

Video hosting and protected video delivery

Student dashboards and user account systems

Automated certificates

Online quizzes and examinations

Course progress tracking

Responsive/mobile-first development

Website security and access control

API and third-party software integrations



Experience with SCORM, xAPI, H5P or other e-learning standards is a strong advantage.



What We Are Looking For



We want a developer who thinks beyond simply "building a website."



You should be able to help us create a professional online training academy with an excellent student experience from the moment someone visits the website through:



Course Discovery ? Registration ? Payment ? Training ? Testing ? Completion ? Certification



The platform should look professional, modern, trustworthy and comparable to a legitimate online vocational or professional certification school.



Important



Our Instructional Design Specialist will be responsible for creating the curriculum and much of the educational content.



Your responsibility will be turning that curriculum into a functional, polished and scalable online learning platform.

This project will begin with development of the NAMVS online academy, but we expect the platform to continue expanding with:



Additional marine surveying courses

Specialty certifications

Continuing education programs

Advanced professional courses

Student membership programs

Recurring training and certification requirements

Engage365 is a U.S.-based digital marketing agency helping businesses grow through digital marketing, content, paid advertising, SEO, automation, and AI-powered solutions.

We're looking for an experienced SEO & AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) Specialist who can take ownership of this initiative and help us grow our visibility across both traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.



About the Role



This is a hands-on, part-time position for someone who can develop an SEO/AEO strategy and execute it independently.



We are not looking for a general virtual assistant or someone who needs to be given a weekly checklist of SEO tasks.



We want someone who can review our website and data, identify opportunities, determine what should be prioritized, execute the work, monitor performance, and tell us what we should do next.



Management will provide business context, approvals, and resources when needed, but you will be the SEO specialist and will own the day-to-day SEO/AEO function.



Our primary goals are to:



Increase qualified organic traffic

Generate more organic leads

Improve rankings for high-intent commercial keywords

Build topical authority around our services

Improve our visibility in AI-powered search and answer engines



What You'll Own:



SEO Strategy & Research

Conduct an initial SEO audit and establish current performance benchmarks

Develop a prioritized 90-day SEO/AEO roadmap

Conduct keyword, competitor, search-intent, and content-gap research

Identify high-intent commercial keyword opportunities

Determine which service pages and content should be prioritized

Identify opportunities based on Google Search Console and ranking data

Continuously adjust priorities based on performance

On-Page SEO

Optimize page titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, images, and website copy

Improve page structure and search-intent alignment

Optimize existing service and landing pages

Identify opportunities for new service or landing pages

Build and improve internal linking

Improve topical relationships between pages

Make recommendations that improve both rankings and user experience

Technical SEO

Monitor indexing and crawlability

Identify technical SEO issues

Monitor sitemap and indexing health

Identify broken links, redirects, duplicate content, and other SEO issues

Implement appropriate schema/structured data

Monitor Core Web Vitals and site performance from an SEO perspective

Clearly document larger technical issues for our development team when necessary



You are not expected to be a web developer. You should, however, be able to identify technical SEO problems, handle reasonable SEO implementations, and clearly explain development requirements when additional support is needed.



Content Strategy & Optimization

Develop an SEO-focused content strategy

Identify topics based on search opportunity, competition, and business value

Build topical clusters around our services

Create content briefs and outlines

Optimize new content before publication

Refresh and improve existing content

Ensure content satisfies search intent

Use AI tools appropriately to improve efficiency while maintaining quality

Help ensure content sounds natural, useful, and written for a U.S. audience



This is not primarily a high-volume blog-writing position. Your responsibility is making sure our content strategy supports organic growth and that the content we publish is properly optimized.



AEO / AI Search Optimization



A major part of this position will be helping Engage365 adapt to the changing search landscape.



You will:



Optimize content for AI-powered search and answer engines

Research opportunities to increase visibility in platforms such as ChatGPT, Google AI experiences, Perplexity, and other emerging platforms

Structure content so important questions are answered clearly and accurately

Identify opportunities for FAQ, comparison, definition, service, and answer-focused content

Improve entity signals and topical authority

Implement appropriate structured data

Monitor our brand and competitor visibility across AI search platforms where practical

Stay current on developments in AEO/GEO and AI search

Recommend new strategies as the industry evolves



We understand that AEO is an evolving field and that measurement is still developing. We are not looking for someone who promises guaranteed rankings or citations in ChatGPT.



We want someone who understands how search is changing, stays informed, tests strategies, and applies what is working.



Authority & Off-Page SEO

Monitor our backlink profile

Research competitor backlinks

Identify high-quality backlink opportunities

Identify relevant directories, citations, partnerships, and other authority-building opportunities

Conduct limited outreach when appropriate

Avoid spammy, low-quality, or potentially harmful link-building tactics



High-volume backlink outreach and full-scale digital PR are not the primary focus of this role.



Analytics & Reporting

Monitor Google Search Console

Monitor GA4

Track keyword rankings

Track organic traffic

Track organic leads and conversions

Monitor pages gaining or losing visibility

Maintain a record of SEO work completed

Use performance data to determine future priorities



You will provide a concise monthly report explaining:



What was completed

What changed

What is improving

What isn't improving

Opportunities or problems you've identified

What you recommend prioritizing next



We don't want a 40-page automated SEO report. We want to understand what is happening, why it matters, and what we're doing next.



What Success Looks Like



We're hiring this person to grow qualified organic visibility and lead generation for Engage365.



Over time, we expect to see measurable improvements in:



Qualified organic traffic

Non-branded search visibility

Rankings for high-intent commercial keywords

Organic leads and conversions

Performance of important service pages

Overall technical SEO health

Topical authority

Quality referring domains

AI/answer-engine visibility where it can reasonably be measured



We understand that SEO takes time and do not expect immediate rankings or lead growth within the first few weeks.



We care about long-term business results, not simply publishing a certain number of articles or completing a certain number of SEO tasks each month.



Required Qualifications

Fluent written and spoken English — REQUIRED

Excellent English writing, editing, and communication skills

Ability to write and edit naturally for a U.S. audience

3+ years of hands-on SEO experience preferred

Experience independently managing SEO for a business website

Strong understanding of on-page SEO

Working knowledge of technical SEO

Strong keyword and competitor research skills

Strong understanding of search intent

Experience with Google Search Console

Experience with Google Analytics 4

Experience with SEMrush, Ahrefs, or comparable SEO platforms

Understanding of schema and structured data

Understanding of internal linking and website architecture

Understanding of SEO content strategy

Familiarity with AEO/GEO and AI-powered search

Comfortable using AI tools as part of an SEO workflow

Ability to research problems and make recommendations independently

Strong organizational and time-management skills

Nice to Have



Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:



Digital marketing agencies

B2B or SMB marketing

Local SEO

WordPress or similar CMS platforms

Conversion rate optimization

Backlink research

Website migrations or rebrands

AI search visibility tools

Marketing automation or AI-related businesses

The Person We're Looking For



We want someone who is comfortable coming to us and saying:



"Here's what I'm seeing, here's why it matters, and here's what I recommend we do next."



Rather than:



"What SEO tasks would you like me to work on this week?"



You will have access to management for questions, approvals, business context, and resources, but we're hiring you because you are the SEO specialist.



You should be:



Proactive

Analytical

Curious

Reliable

Detail-oriented

Organized

Comfortable working independently

Willing to learn and experiment

Interested in how AI is changing search

Compensation & Schedule



This is a long-term, part-time independent contractor position.



Starting rate: $8–$10 USD/hour, depending on experience.



We expect approximately 12–15 hours per week to start.



There is potential for additional hours and increased compensation over time based on performance, results, and business needs.



Your work schedule can generally be flexible, although some availability during U.S. Eastern Time business hours will be required for occasional communication and meetings.



How to Apply



Please
 your application directly to:







Use the subject line:



SEO & AEO Specialist Application – [Your Name]



Your application must include:



A brief introduction about yourself and your SEO experience

Your resume

Your portfolio, if available

2–3 websites you have personally worked on and exactly what you were responsible for

One SEO result you're particularly proud of, including what you did and the results you achieved

The SEO tools you regularly use

Your experience with AEO/GEO and AI search optimization

Your experience using AI tools as part of your SEO workflow

Your current weekly availability

Your requested hourly rate

A brief response to this question:



If you took over SEO for a marketing agency that recently completed a full rebrand and had done very little SEO since the rebrand, what would you focus on during your first 30 days?



Important



Fluent written and spoken English is required for this position.



To confirm that you've read the entire job posting, please begin your
 with the words:



Organic Growth



Applications that do not include a resume and the requested information may not be considered.

title: Home Care Recruiter & Onboarding Specialist (Caregiver Hiring, US Hours)
description:
Senior Helpers of Cincinnati is a locally owned in-home senior care agency serving the Greater Cincinnati and Hamilton County, Ohio area. We're looking for one remote person to run our caregiver hiring pipeline - sourcing, screening, interviewing, tracking, and onboarding.



This is the whole pipeline, not a piece of it.



Our workday runs on US Eastern time, so we'd want enough overlap to reach applicants during their day.



WHAT YOU'D BE DOING



1) SOURCING AND SCREENING

- Work applications as they come in through our applicant tracking system

- Phone screen candidates for experience, reliability, transportation, availability, and comfort with hands-on personal care

- Follow up with the ones who went quiet or missed a call. A lot of good home care hires come from the second and third try, not the first.



2) INTERVIEWING

- Run structured video interviews through our interviewing platform

- Score candidates against a set rubric and give us a clear recommendation with your notes



3) TRACKING

- Keep a live hiring tracker in Google Sheets: every applicant, what stage they're in, next action, and date

- A short daily pipeline update so we always know the numbers

- Chase missing documents until they are in hand



4) ONBOARDING

- Send and collect new hire paperwork: I-9, W-4, direct deposit, policy acknowledgments

- Order background checks and TB tests and follow them through to completion

- Set up new caregivers in our scheduling system and assign their online training

- Confirm each caregiver is fully cleared before their first shift



WHO WE THINK FITS

- Experience recruiting or onboarding for a US home care, home health, staffing, or healthcare agency. Agency-side experience means more to us than general VA work.

- Excellent spoken English. You would be on the phone with American applicants every day.

- Comfortable with a high volume of outbound calls and texts

- Solid Google Sheets skills. The tracker would be yours to build and keep current.

- Enough overlap with US Eastern business hours to reach people during our day

- Reliable internet, a quiet place to take calls, and a headset

- Nice to have: WellSky / ClearCare, Hireology, or Care Academy experience



PAY

Negotiable. Let us know what you would want and how you would rather structure it.



TO APPLY

It would help if you could include:

1. Your home care or healthcare recruiting experience: agency name, your role, how long

2. A short voice recording of you speaking English, 30 to 60 seconds. Tell us about a caregiver you hired and why they worked out. We listen to every one of these.

3. What you would want to be paid, in USD

4. Your available hours in US Eastern Time



The voice recording matters to us because this role lives on the phone. Thanks for reading this far. We're looking forward to hearing from you.

title: Short-form video editor - vertical social videos (paid trial batch, ongoing work available)
description:
We are a Canadian digital marketing agency. We need a short-form video editor for a paid trial batch, starting immediately.



THE WORK

We have raw footage and assets for two of our client brands (one in health services, one in residential construction) that need to be cut into vertical short-form social videos.



- Format: 9:16 vertical, roughly 20-45 seconds each

- Faceless / b-roll driven - no on-camera presenter required

- You will handle: cutting and pacing, a hook in the first 2 seconds, burned-in captions, music and sound design, simple text/motion graphics, colour and audio cleanup

- Delivered ready to post



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Strong sense of pacing and retention for TikTok / Reels / YouTube Shorts

- Clean, modern, brand-appropriate style - not heavy meme editing

- Accurate, well-timed captions in English

- Reliable turnaround and clear communication

- Able to follow a brand style once it is set, so the output stays consistent



HOW THIS WORKS

This starts as a one-off paid trial batch so we can see your work on our real footage. If it goes well we have ongoing monthly volume available (30+ videos per month) and would move to a regular arrangement. We would rather find one editor and keep them busy than re-hire every month.



We pay per finished video. Tell us your rate.



TO APPLY, please answer these four things:

1. Send 2-3 examples of vertical short-form videos you personally edited (links are fine)

2. Your rate per finished video

3. Your typical turnaround for a batch of 10 videos

4. Which editing software you use



Please do not send a generic copy-paste application. We read every one and we reply to the applications that answer the four points above.

title: Outbound Call Center Agent
description:
About Us

We are one of the largest Hand & Stone Massage and Facial Spa franchise groups in the United States — 16+ spa locations across the country, and still opening more. Hand & Stone is one of America’s leading spa brands, helping hundreds of thousands of clients every year feel better through professional massage, facial, and wellness services.

Behind those spas is a remote outbound team that keeps our appointment books full — and we treat that team like true employees, not freelancers. Many of our agents have been with us for years. We invest in training, celebrate wins loudly, run contests constantly, and promote from within as we grow. When you join us, you’re joining a stable, growing American company that considers you part of the family.

Why You’ll Love This Job

• Guaranteed monthly salary — 42,000–55,000/month depending on experience, paid reliably, on time, every time. No waiting on clients or chasing invoices.

• Uncapped commissions — you earn on every appointment you book. Our top performers take home 85,000–115,000+ per month all-in.

• Warm leads only — every person you call has already asked about our services. No cold calling, no hostile hang-ups — just friendly conversations with people who want to book.

• Permanent work from home — a long-term, full-time career, not a short gig. Skip the commute and build your future from home.

• Contests, bonuses & recognition — regular contests and incentives that keep the work fun and put extra money in your pocket.

• Real career growth — we promote from within. Agents grow into team lead, training, and operations roles as we open new locations.

• Paid training & real support — proven scripts, ongoing coaching, and leadership that wants you to win.

What You’ll Do

• Call and text warm leads who requested information about massages, facials, and spa services — and book them into appointments at our spas

• Follow up with interested prospects until they book, with professionalism, confidence, and empathy

• Educate clients on our services, memberships, and current promotions to build excitement

• Hit daily and weekly booking goals with full support and coaching from leadership

• Log every call outcome accurately in our booking system

What We’re Looking For

• Excellent spoken and written English with a clear, friendly phone voice

• A confident, positive, coachable personality and the drive to meet goals

• Availability to work 40 hours/week during US business hours (night shift, Philippine time)

• Reliable high-speed internet, a quality headset, and a quiet workspace

• Sales, appointment setting, or call center experience is a plus — but attitude matters more



How to Apply

Start your application with the word SERENITY so we know you read this far. Then send us:

•	Your resume

•	A short note on why you’re a great fit

•	A 1–2 minute voice recording introducing yourself (a link is fine — Vocaroo works great)

•	A screenshot of your internet speed test from Speedtest.net

We review every complete application and respond quickly. We can’t wait to meet you!

title: Senior Graphic Designer / Print Production Designer

Promotional products

Invitations and specialty stationery

Product mockups and customer proofs

Typography and professional layout

Vector illustration and vector recreation

Schedule

title: PPC Specialist
description:
# PPC Specialist — HVAC Google Search



**Location:** Remote

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Industry:** HVAC & Home Services



## About the Role



We’re looking for an experienced **PPC Specialist** who specializes in **Google Search Ads for HVAC and other service-based businesses**.



You’ll be responsible for managing multiple HVAC client accounts, optimizing campaigns, driving qualified leads, and continuously improving campaign performance.



This is a performance-focused role. We care about **qualified leads, cost per lead, booked jobs, and client growth** — not just clicks and impressions.



## What You'll Do



* Manage multiple Google Ads accounts for HVAC clients

* Build, launch, and optimize Google Search campaigns from the ground up

* Perform keyword research and develop high-intent keyword strategies

* Create and optimize campaigns around services such as:



  * AC repair

  * AC installation

  * Furnace repair

  * Furnace installation

  * HVAC maintenance

  * Heating & cooling

  * Emergency HVAC

  * Commercial HVAC

* Analyze search terms and continuously add negative keywords

* Optimize bids, budgets, targeting, locations, and campaign structure

* Write and test high-converting search ad copy

* Monitor CPL, conversion rates, lead volume, and lead quality

* Identify opportunities to scale winning campaigns

* Troubleshoot underperforming campaigns and develop strategies to improve performance

* Monitor conversion tracking and ensure accurate campaign data

* Work with landing pages and tracking systems to improve conversion rates

* Analyze account performance and provide strategic recommendations

* Manage budgets across multiple client accounts

* Stay current with Google Ads updates and PPC best practices



## What We're Looking For



### Required



* **Minimum 2 years of hands-on PPC/Google Ads experience**

* Proven experience managing **Google Search campaigns**

* Experience working with **HVAC, home services, or other service-based businesses**

* Experience managing multiple client accounts simultaneously

* Strong understanding of keyword research, match types, bidding strategies, negative keywords, and campaign structure

* Strong understanding of local search and geographic targeting

* Experience with conversion tracking

* Ability to analyze performance data and make strategic decisions

* Strong understanding of CPL, CPA, conversion rates, and lead quality

* Ability to independently manage and optimize client accounts

* Strong communication and organizational skills



### Big Plus



* Direct HVAC PPC experience

* Experience with Google Local Services Ads

* Experience with Performance Max

* Experience with CallTrackingMetrics, WhatConverts, CallRail, or similar tracking platforms

* Experience connecting Google Ads performance to actual booked jobs and revenue

* Previous experience working at a marketing agency



## What Success Looks Like



Your goal isn't simply to generate leads.



Your goal is to **generate qualified HVAC opportunities at a profitable cost and help our clients grow.**



You should be able to look at an account and quickly understand:



**What's working ? What's not working ? Why ? What needs to change ? How we scale it.**



You'll be responsible for continuously improving:



* Qualified lead volume

* Cost per lead

* Conversion rates

* Search-term quality

* Campaign efficiency

* Budget allocation

* Overall account performance



## Career Growth



We're a growing agency, and we're looking for someone who wants to grow with us.



There is a clear path for progression based on **performance, skill development, and ownership**:



**PPC Specialist ? Senior PPC Specialist ? PPC Account Manager ? Paid Media Manager ? Head of Paid Media**



As you grow, you'll have opportunities to take on larger accounts, manage more responsibility, help build our PPC systems, mentor team members, and move into leadership.



## Compensation & Incentives



We offer:



* Competitive compensation based on experience

* Performance-based bonuses

* Additional performance incentives

* Career progression opportunities

* Ongoing training and professional development

* Remote work

* Opportunity to work with a growing portfolio of HVAC and home-service businesses

* High level of ownership and autonomy



## Who Will Thrive Here?



You'll be a great fit if you:



* Love analyzing data and finding opportunities

* Enjoy optimizing campaigns and seeing performance improve

* Take ownership instead of waiting to be told what to do

* Understand that PPC is about generating **business results**, not just traffic

* Want to develop into a senior PPC strategist or manager

* Enjoy working in a fast-growing environment

* Are comfortable managing multiple accounts and priorities



If you're an experienced **Google Search specialist with a track record in HVAC or service-based PPC**, we'd love to hear from you.



## How to Apply



Please provide:



1. Your resume

2. Your Google Ads experience

3. The service-based industries you've worked with

4. Your HVAC experience, if applicable

5. Examples of Google Search campaigns you've managed

6. Results you've achieved (CPL, lead volume, conversion rate, etc.)

7. How many accounts you've managed simultaneously

8. **Years of hands-on PPC/Google Ads experience**



**Minimum experience: 2 years. HVAC-specific Google Search experience is strongly preferred.**

title: Offshore CPA
description:
Offshore CPA — Personal Injury Settlement File Cleanup & Audit (Contract, Litify + QBO) 



Firm: Pathway Law Firm Type: Independent contractor, full-time hours (40 hrs/wk), fully remote/offshore Duration: 3–6 month cleanup engagement, with strong potential to convert to ongoing long-term work Openings: 2 Overlap required: Minimum 4 hours daily overlap with U.S. Central/Eastern business hours Start: ASAP 



About the work 



We are a personal injury law firm running case management in Litify (Salesforce) and accounting in QuickBooks Online. Our historical case files and settlement records need a disciplined financial cleanup: we are rebuilding client-level subledgers in QBO so that every matter reconciles cleanly against the trust account and against what Litify says happened on the case. 



This is not bookkeeping data entry. This is forensic file review — you will open a settlement file, reconstruct what actually happened financially, find where it broke, and fix it with documentation. 



 



What you will do 



Review closed and open personal injury settlement files end to end from a financial perspective 



Rebuild and maintain client trust (IOLTA) subledgers in QuickBooks Online — one per client/matter — and reconcile them three ways: subledger totals ? trust bank statement ? trust control account in the GL 



Audit settlement statements / disbursement sheets for accuracy: gross settlement, attorney fee calculation against the fee agreement percentage, case costs advanced, medical liens and provider balances, health insurance/ERISA/Medicare/Medicaid liens, referral fee splits, and net to client 



Trace every disbursement against supporting documentation (executed release, signed settlement statement, lien reduction letters, cost receipts, cleared checks) 



Reconcile Litify case financial records — matter records, settlement/negotiation objects, expense and lien records, related documents — against QBO and flag discrepancies 



Identify and document exceptions: unapplied funds, stale outstanding checks, negative client balances, commingling risk, costs never reimbursed to the firm, unreleased liens, missing signatures, math errors on the statement 



Clear the exception log by working with our case managers and attorneys, or escalate with a written recommendation 



Build and follow a repeatable review checklist; document your workpapers so a third party can follow them 



Report weekly on files reviewed, files cleared, exceptions open, and dollars at issue 



Required qualifications 



CPA or Chartered Accountant (or an equivalent recognized designation in your country) — please state your license/registration number and jurisdiction 



Hands-on Litify experience is required. You must have worked inside Litify day to day — not just generic Salesforce. Be prepared to describe specific Litify objects, page layouts, and reports you have used, and to demonstrate navigation during the interview 



Working knowledge of Salesforce navigation, list views, and report building 



Demonstrated experience with U.S. law firm trust/IOLTA accounting and three-way reconciliation 



Direct experience reviewing personal injury settlement statements, medical liens, and lien reductions 



Strong QuickBooks Online skills, including class/customer:job or project-level tracking used to produce client subledgers 



Advanced Excel or Google Sheets (pivot tables, XLOOKUP/INDEX-MATCH, reconciliation workbooks) 



Excellent written English — you will be documenting findings that attorneys read and rely on 



Reliable high-speed internet, a private work environment, and a computer capable of running Salesforce and QBO simultaneously 



Nice to have 



Prior work with a U.S. plaintiff-side PI firm or a legal-accounting BPO 



Familiarity with Medicare Secondary Payer / conditional payment resolution and ERISA plan liens 



Experience with QBO cleanup projects and reconstructing prior-period records 



Exposure to LawPay, Gravity Legal, or similar legal payment processors 



Litify Financials / Litify Payments module experience 



What we care about most 



We would rather have one person who can look at a settlement statement and immediately see that the fee was calculated on the wrong base, the lien was reduced but never rebooked, and the client was short-paid $1,840 — than three people who can only reconcile what they're handed. Judgment and skepticism matter more than speed.

description:
Type: Full-time · Remote Salary: $1,000 USD fixed price + month + performance bonuses for extra scope Start: ASAP the core dashboard must be live before Q4 (October at the absolute latest)



The problem we want you to solve



We run a multi-brand e-commerce group with 5 Shopify stores across the UK, US & EU , spending daily on Meta, Google and Pinterest Ads.



Right now our numbers live in different places: Shopify admin, three ad platforms, supplier COGS sheets, refund reports, spreadsheets. Every decision starts with tab-switching and manual checking.



We want one screen. A command center where we open a browser tab and instantly see, per store and blended: revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, ROAS, blended ROAS, profit and profit margin for today, the last 7 days, the last 30 days, or any custom date range.



If you have built something like this before, this job is straightforward for you. If you haven't, please don't apply.



What you will build (Phase 1)



Data connections



All 5 Shopify stores connected via API, with a clean architecture so we can add store #6, #7, #8 later without a rebuild

Meta Ads, Google Ads and Pinterest Ads connected for live ad spend per store

COGS pulled in per store either from Shopify or from our supplier system / cost sheets



Metrics

Revenue, ad spend, COGS, refunds, contribution margin

ROAS per platform and blended ROAS

Net profit and profit % per store and across the group

Order count, AOV, refund rate



Views



A multi-store view: everything visible in one consolidated set of charts

A per-store view: drill into any single brand

Clear, readable graphs for yesterday / 7 days / 30 days, plus a custom date picker

Period-over-period comparison so we can see whether we are growing or bleeding



Automation



Daily Slack update with yesterday's key numbers per store

Weekly Slack update with growth vs. the previous week

Must-have requirements

A demonstrable track record building a P&L / profit dashboard. Screenshots, a live demo, a Loom walkthrough or a repo — we want proof, not promises.

Comfortable working with APIs and API keys (Shopify Admin API, Meta Marketing API, Google Ads API, Pinterest API)

Hands-on with Supabase and/or Vercel for building and deploying

You work with Claude Code, Claude or Codex as part of your daily workflow — we build fast here

Strong Excel / Google Sheets skills — a lot of our cost and supplier data still starts life in a spreadsheet

Good written English and reliable daily communication



Bonus points (this is how you earn more)

Bookkeeping / accounting skills. We also need our finance side organized — invoices, costs and P&L all in one clean place. If you can build that system (or run it yourself), tell us. This alone can raise your offer.

You can optimize multiple workflows: sheet automation, accounting flows, backend dashboards. The more of our stack you can own, the more projects we hand you.

Experience with e-commerce / dropshipping data specifically

Growth path



Phase 1 is the P&L command center. After that we want to build:



A supply chain dashboard on top of the same system

A product listing system



This can run as a long-term full-time role or as project-based work — whichever fits you better. We are open to your proposal.



How to apply



Read this carefully, because we filter hard on it.



Start your message with the word READY. Applications that don't will be deleted unread.



Then send us:



Your track record — links, screenshots, a demo or a Loom of a P&L or analytics dashboard you actually built. Show us the real thing.

What you would build for us — the stack you'd use and a rough timeline to get Phase 1 live.

How you'd handle COGS — in 3 sentences: how would you get accurate cost-of-goods into the dashboard when it doesn't live cleanly inside Shopify? (This tells us more than a CV does.)

Your position on the offer — confirm you're open to $1,000 USD/month, or make us a proposal. If you want to build the extra pieces (accounting system, supply chain, listing tool) tell us what that's worth and we'll talk. We pay for people who make us money.



We reply fast to strong applications. Looking forward to seeing what you've built.

Entry Level Details

We will train you on how to take customers through the sales process.

Log call outcomes and notes accurately.

Send follow-up
s and text messages when necessary.

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINKELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Identify decision-makers and schedule callbacks or appointments.

Communicate feedback and common objections to the team.



Requirements

Previous experience in cold calling, telemarketing, appointment setting, or a similar outbound sales role.

Experience making a large number of calls daily.

Ability to follow a defined process and use scripts effectively.

Strong conversational and listening skills.

Comfortable handling rejection and maintaining a positive attitude.

Excellent spoken English and clear communication skills.

Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

Experience calling businesses or working in B2B sales.

Familiarity with CRMs and dialing software.

Experience working remotely.







What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experience lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINKELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here. 





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed. 

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system. 

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

title: Product Designer (UX/UI) — AI Start Up
description:
EchoVerse Collective — Product Designer (UX/UI)



We build agents for humans. We currently have Dispatches, It is written by four AI columnists and approved by a named human editor before anything ships. You can read it at 
/dispatches. Every article carries an editorial score. Every article has an audio edition. 



The product works. The design has never been properly reviewed.



We are hiring a product designer to tell us what is wrong with it, and then fix it.



THE WORK



A one-month project, full-time, at PHP 100,000. Potential to be permanent. 



Three parts:



1. A full review of the reading experience, on desktop and on mobile.

2. Prioritised design fixes for what you find.

3. Implementation-ready specs for the top items, handed to our engineers.



If the month goes well, it continues. We have more surfaces coming — a mobile app, subscriber areas, a second product — and we would rather keep one designer who knows the publication than start again each time.



We want someone who can look at a real publication and say: here is where a first-time reader gets lost, here is where the hierarchy fights itself, here is the thing they built that nobody can find.



YOU WILL FIT IF



- You have designed things before, a publication, a newsletter, a content product, or anything where people read for longer than thirty seconds. Show us that work.

- You can rank problems. A list of twenty issues is not useful. Five, ordered by what they cost the user, is.

- You write clearly. Most of this job is explaining why something is wrong.

- You are comfortable explaining your thinking.



YOU WILL NOT FIT IF



- Your portfolio is just landing pages and dashboard concepts.

- You need a detailed brief before you can start.

- You only describe your work by what you made rather than by what changed.



DETAILS



- PHP 100,000 for the first month, full-time, fully remote.

- We are in London (GMT+1). We need three hours of overlap — your afternoon covers it.

- English is the working language. The publication is written in British English..



HOW TO APPLY — two things, both required



1. Your portfolio. A link. Point us at the one or two projects closest in relevance, and tell us in one line each what you changed and why.



2. Three observations about our site. Spend twenty minutes on 
/dispatches — the front page and one dispatch. Tell us the three biggest problems you find. For each: what is wrong, who it hurts, and what you would do instead. Keep it short at this stage. A few hundred words is plenty.



Applications with a portfolio and no observations will not be read.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



From everyone who applies we intended to shortlist about 5 people. Those ten are asked for a proper written review of the site, and 30 minute conversation.



We pay PHP 1,500 for that review. Everyone who reaches that round is paid, on delivery, whether or not we hire you. It is not a competition prize and it is not conditional on us liking what you wrote. If we asked you for it, you are paid for it.



From those ten, one person gets the job.

title: Accounts Receivable and Billing Specialist
description:

Accounts Receivable & Billing Specialist



Job Type: Full- Time



Work Hours: Monday to Friday 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Pacific Time, with 1-hour break 



Salary: $1,400



Job Overview



We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized Accounts Receivable & Billing Specialist to support billing operations within a construction-focused environment. This role is responsible for preparing and submitting customer invoices and pay applications, maintaining accurate receivable records, and ensuring timely payment collection.



The ideal candidate has experience in construction billing workflows, including AIA pay applications, lien waivers, and contractor billing portals. This position requires strong process discipline, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining accurate documentation.



Key Responsibilities



Billing & Pay Application Management



Prepare customer invoices based on information provided by Project Managers

Coordinate with Project Managers to ensure invoices include all required supporting documentation

Prepare and submit construction pay applications, including AIA billing forms (G702/G703), when required

Submit invoices and billing documentation in accordance with customer-specific requirements

Upload invoices, pay applications, lien waivers, and supporting documentation through contractor billing portals such as Textura, GC Pay, Struxtion, Procore, Procore Pay, Trimble Pay (formerly Flashtract), and BuildingConnected Pay

Confirm invoices and pay applications have been successfully submitted and accepted

Lien Waivers & Documentation

Request lien releases from vendors and suppliers related to company payments

Maintain organized electronic records of billing documentation and submissions

Accounts Receivable Tracking



Enter customer payments into Sage 100 (or similar accounting systems) and apply payments to invoices

Track receivable balances and assist with maintaining internal receivable tracking records

Follow up with customers via
 regarding invoice receipt and payment status

Provide updates to management regarding invoice status and outstanding receivables

General Support



Maintain accurate, organized financial records

Ensure compliance with structured billing processes and internal SOPs

Support additional accounting and billing-related tasks as needed

Qualifications



Experience



3–5 years of accounts receivable, billing, or accounting experience 

Experience working for a U.S.-based construction contractor or subcontractor  preferred

Experience preparing or submitting construction pay applications (AIA billing) preferred

Technical Skills



Experience using accounting systems such as Sage 100 or similar platforms

Experience working with construction billing portals such as Textura, GC Pay, Struxtion, Procore, Procore Pay, Trimble Pay, or BuildingConnected Pay strongly preferred

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Outlook

Process Knowledge



Understanding of construction billing workflows including pay applications, retainage tracking, lien waivers, and receivable follow-up processes

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

Strong written communication skills for working with customers and internal teams



Note: An NBI or police clearance will be required upon acceptance of the job offer.

title: Mental Health Billing Specialist
description:
Now Hiring: Mental Health Billing Specialist (Remote)



Healthcare Partners Consulting & Billing is seeking an experienced Mental Health Billing Specialist to join our team.



This is not a “submit claims and move on” position. We are looking for someone who understands the full revenue cycle and takes responsibility for getting providers paid accurately and timely.



If you are used to pushing claims and waiting, this is not the role for you.



About this role:

You will be responsible for managing claims from submission through payment, identifying issues, and resolving them. This includes working denials, following up with payers, and ensuring claims are processed correctly from the start.



Responsibilities include:



Submitting clean claims for mental health services

Reviewing sessions to ensure billing accuracy before submission

Following up on unpaid and underpaid claims

Working denials and rejections with urgency and accuracy

Communicating with insurance companies and documenting reference numbers

Identifying patterns and reporting issues that impact revenue

Maintaining accurate notes and documentation in all systems



Requirements:



Minimum 2 years of mental health billing experience

Strong understanding of the full revenue cycle, not just claim submission

Experience working with insurance companies and handling denials

Ability to read and interpret EOBs and payer responses

High attention to detail and accuracy

Ability to manage multiple providers and priorities at once



Our expectation:

Submitting claims is the lowest level of this role. The value is in identifying problems, preventing denials, and getting claims paid.



We expect our team to understand payer behavior, stay current, and embrace AI and technology to improve efficiency. If you are not willing to learn and adapt, this will not be a fit.



Schedule:



Monday through Thursday: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM

Friday: Half day. 8-1



Compensation & Benefits:



Salary based on experience

Career ladder with growth opportunities

Paid holidays (US Holidays)



How to Apply (Read Carefully):



Complete the online job application below
