title: Join Our Star Wars YouTube Team as a Long Form Video Editor
description:
**Not just another editing job. We're looking for a storyteller.**



If you know how to keep viewers glued to a 30 to 40-minute video, love cinematic editing, and can bring Star Wars lore to life through visuals, this might be the role for you.



We're building one of the fastest-growing Star Wars documentary channels, and we're looking for an editor who understands pacing, storytelling, and how to create videos that people can't stop watching.



## What You'll Do



• Edit cinematic 30 to 40-minute Star Wars videos

• Match visuals perfectly with narration

• Source official media, gameplay, cinematics, artwork, and other relevant assets

• Build engaging pacing that keeps viewers watching until the end

• Add music, sound design, and transitions that enhance the story

• Follow our channel's editing style closely



## Who We're Looking For



• You edit using **DaVinci Resolve** (preferred) or **Adobe Premiere Pro** only

• You have experience editing **long-form YouTube content**

• You understand storytelling, pacing, and audience retention

• You're detail-oriented and enjoy researching visuals that accurately match the script

• Experience using AI tools is a bonus



## This Role Is NOT for You If



• You only edit short-form content

• You primarily use CapCut or mobile editing apps

• You struggle with long-form storytelling or sourcing visuals



## To Apply



Send us:



• Your portfolio

• Your best long-form editing samples

• The editing software you use

• Your age

• A short introduction about yourself and your editing experience



We're looking for editors who care about quality, enjoy storytelling, and want to create content that Star Wars fans will love.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to see your work.

# Full-Time Video Editor, Remote



**$500 USD/month | Remote | Long-term opportunity**



**Apply here:**





Bespoke Agency is looking for a talented Video Editor to join our team full-time.



We’re a growing UK-based AI and growth consultancy producing podcasts, founder-led content and social media content for ourselves and our clients.



We create a lot of content.



We’re looking for someone who wants to become the person we can trust to take raw footage and consistently turn it into excellent finished content.



This is not a freelance project or short-term gig.



We want someone looking for a stable, long-term role where they can improve their craft, take ownership of their work and grow alongside the company.



## What You'll Work On



Your main responsibility will be editing podcast and social media content.



You'll be:



* Editing short-form clips for LinkedIn, Instagram and other social platforms

* Turning 30 to 60-minute podcast episodes into engaging short-form content

* Editing full podcast episodes when required

* Adding captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects and visual elements where appropriate

* Finding the strongest hooks and moments from longer conversations

* Helping us improve the overall quality and style of our content

* Using AI editing tools to make your workflow faster and more efficient

* Organising projects and delivering finished content on schedule



A large part of your job will be taking something that is **good** and asking:



**"How can I make this noticeably better?"**



## The Type of Person We're Looking For



We care much more about your ability than your CV.



You might be a great fit if:



* You genuinely enjoy video editing

* You have experience editing podcasts or short-form content

* You understand pacing, hooks and retention

* You notice the small details other editors miss

* You can follow creative direction while also bringing your own ideas

* You're comfortable receiving feedback and improving quickly

* You're reliable and communicate clearly

* You can manage your workload without somebody constantly chasing you

* You want to become a seriously good editor over the next few years



We don't expect perfection from day one.



We do expect **effort, ownership and improvement.**



## Think This Sounds Like You?



Don’t overthink it. We’d rather see your work than read a perfectly polished CV.



**Apply here:**





## Editing Tools



You should already be comfortable using professional editing software such as:



* Adobe Premiere Pro

* DaVinci Resolve

* Final Cut Pro

* CapCut



Experience with AI tools such as Descript, Higgsfield or other AI-powered editing tools is a bonus.



More importantly, we want someone curious enough to constantly test better ways of producing content.



## What Good Performance Looks Like



You'll succeed in this role if:



* Content is delivered when promised

* Your edits require fewer revisions over time

* You learn our preferred editing style quickly

* You proactively suggest better hooks, cuts and creative ideas

* You communicate early if there is ever a problem

* The quality of your editing visibly improves month after month



We want someone who eventually understands our content so well that we don't need to explain every decision.



## Compensation



**$500 USD per month**



Full-time, remote position.



We are specifically open to applicants based in the Philippines.



There is an opportunity for compensation to increase as you demonstrate strong performance, reliability and greater responsibility within the company.



For the right person, we want this to become a long-term role.



## Why Join Bespoke Agency?



You'll be joining a small, ambitious team rather than disappearing into a huge company.



That means your work matters.



You'll have:



* Consistent editing work

* Clear creative direction

* Direct feedback

* Exposure to podcasts, founders and business content

* Access to new AI editing workflows and tools

* The ability to influence how our content evolves

* Opportunities to take on more responsibility as the company grows



If you're ambitious about becoming a better editor, there will be plenty for you to sink your teeth into.



## The Hiring Process



We've deliberately kept the application simple.



### Step 1



Complete our application form.



### Step 2



If your application stands out, we'll invite you to complete a short **paid editing trial**.



### Step 3



The strongest candidates will have a short interview with our team.



Then we'll make the hire.



## Before You Apply



Please don't apply if you're looking to juggle several full-time jobs simultaneously.



We're looking for someone who wants to become a genuine part of the team.



You do not need a university degree.



You do not need a perfect CV.



You do need to show us that you can edit.



**Your portfolio will matter more than almost anything else.**



If you're hungry to improve, take ownership and build with a growing team, we'd like to hear from you.



**Apply here:**

title: Amazon Catalog & Listing Specialist (Flat Files), Premium & Heritage Brands
description:
We are an established Amazon agency (20+ years) managing premium and heritage brands in categories like tabletop, glassware, home, and gift. Many of these brands are older companies whose product data was built for retail, not for Amazon, so it arrives incomplete and messy. We are hiring an experienced catalog specialist to take that data and get it live, accurate, and fully indexed on Amazon at scale.

This role is a fit if you have several years of hands-on experience building and fixing Amazon listings through flat files across large catalogs, and you are current on how Amazon search and indexing work today. If your experience is editing listings one at a time in the Seller Central interface, and you have not worked with flat files at scale, this is not the right role for you.

What the role involves:



Taking brand product data and getting it live correctly: right category, right flat file template, valid values, titles, bullets, backend, images mapped

Bulk uploads and error triage across catalogs with thousands of SKUs

Diagnosing and fixing de-indexed, suppressed, and buy-box-suppressed listings

Verifying that backend changes actually propagate to the live listing, and resolving it when they do not

Keeping catalog and pricing data clean in SellerCloud

Reading and maintaining SOPs



Requirements:



Multiple years building and fixing Amazon listings via flat files, with real examples you can show

Strong command of category templates, valid values, bulk uploads, and error troubleshooting at scale

Current understanding of how Amazon search works now, including Rufus and Cosmo and semantic indexing

Experience with large or messy catalogs and incomplete source data is a major plus

Familiarity with tools such as Seller Central, FlatFile Pro, SellerCloud or a similar ERP, ChannelMax or other repricers, Helium 10, and Excel

Reliable, consistent daily hours with some overlap with US Eastern Time

ClickUp for tasks and time tracking (we will train you)



How to apply (we screen carefully, applications that skip these steps are not reviewed):



Start your subject line with the word TANGIER.

Answer these three questions in your own words, briefly and specifically. We are judging how you think, and generic or AI-written answers are easy to spot.



a. A listing has had zero impressions for a full month. What is the first thing you check, and why?



b. What are Rufus and Cosmo, and how have they changed the way you fill out a flat file? If you have not worked with them yet, say so, and tell me how you would get up to speed.



c. Describe one specific listing or catalog problem you fixed: what was wrong, how you found it, what you did, and the result. One short paragraph.



d. what are the latest Amazon Title guidelines and what does a good title like for a heritage brand?

 

Optional, but it helps: attach a flat file you have built or a screenshot of a bulk-upload error you resolved.

Include your CV.

title: Vendor Operations Manager
description:
# Lead Vendor Manager



## Job Overview



We are looking for a strong, organized, and highly assertive **Lead Vendor Manager** to manage and grow our network of lead vendors. This person will be responsible for finding new vendors, onboarding them into our system, making sure they understand our rules, managing day-to-day vendor communication, handling disputes, tracking performance, and coordinating vendor payments.



This role is not for someone passive. We need someone who can build relationships but also hold vendors accountable, enforce standards, and protect the company from bad traffic, poor-quality leads, compliance issues, and unnecessary payment disputes.



The ideal candidate is confident, direct, detail-oriented, and comfortable dealing with high-volume vendor communication.



## Key Responsibilities



### Vendor Recruiting & Relationship Building



* Actively search for and solicit new lead vendors.

* Build relationships with vendors who can generate qualified insurance leads or transferred calls.

* Explain our program, qualification standards, payment structure, and compliance rules.

* Maintain a pipeline of potential vendors and follow up consistently.

* Help evaluate whether new vendors are a good fit before they are approved.



### Vendor Onboarding



* Guide new vendors through the onboarding process.

* Make sure vendors are set up correctly in our vendor system.

* Train vendors on call requirements, lead qualifications, transfer expectations, hours of operation, and compliance rules.

* Confirm that vendors understand what is billable and non-billable before they begin sending traffic.

* Work with internal team members to make sure vendor setup, tracking, and reporting are accurate.



### Vendor Performance Management



* Monitor vendor lead/call quality.

* Track vendor volume, conversion quality, disputes, rejected leads, and payment trends.

* Identify vendors who are sending low-quality traffic or failing to follow instructions.

* Communicate clearly with vendors when performance needs to improve.

* Recommend pausing, reducing, or terminating vendor relationships when needed.



### Dispute Management



* Handle vendor disputes professionally and firmly.

* Review disputed calls/leads against company rules and qualification standards.

* Communicate payment decisions clearly to vendors.

* Keep organized records of disputes, approvals, rejections, and final outcomes.

* Protect the company from paying for unqualified or non-compliant leads.



### Vendor Payments



* Prepare and review vendor payment reports.

* Confirm billable leads/calls before payment is issued.

* Coordinate weekly vendor payouts.

* Track payment history and resolve payment-related questions.

* Make sure vendors are paid accurately and on time when they meet requirements.



### Compliance & Quality Control



* Ensure vendors follow company guidelines, including DNC requirements, transfer rules, scripting expectations, and call quality standards.

* Watch for red flags such as misrepresentation, poor-quality transfers, recycled leads, non-qualified prospects, or compliance violations.

* Escalate serious vendor issues quickly.

* Maintain clean documentation around vendor rules, disputes, and performance.



## Ideal Candidate



The ideal person for this role is:



* Assertive and confident

* Comfortable having difficult conversations

* Not easily pushed around by vendors

* Organized and detail-oriented

* Strong at follow-up

* Able to balance relationship-building with accountability

* Comfortable enforcing rules and saying “no”

* Fast-moving and proactive

* Good with systems, spreadsheets, CRM tools, and reporting

* Able to manage multiple vendors at once without losing track of details



## Required Skills & Experience



* Experience managing vendors, lead providers, affiliates, call centers, or marketing partners preferred

* Experience in insurance, pay-per-call, lead generation, sales, or performance marketing is a strong plus

* Strong written and verbal communication skills

* Strong negotiation and conflict-resolution skills

* Ability to review data, reports, calls, and dispute records

* High attention to detail

* Comfortable working in a fast-paced sales environment

* Ability to enforce rules without damaging productive relationships

* Reliable, accountable, and self-managed



## Personality Fit



This role requires someone with a strong personality. You must be able to push back when vendors are wrong, challenge questionable traffic, and enforce standards without needing constant direction.



We want someone who is professional and respectful, but also firm, direct, and not afraid of confrontation when necessary.



## Success in This Role Looks Like



* New vendors are consistently being recruited and onboarded.

* Vendors clearly understand our expectations before sending traffic.

* Disputes are handled quickly and fairly.

* Payments are accurate and organized.

* Bad vendors are identified and addressed quickly.

* Good vendors are supported and encouraged to scale.

* Internal teams have fewer vendor-related issues.

* Lead/call quality improves over time.



## Compensation



Compensation will depend on experience and role structure. This may include a base salary or hourly pay, with potential performance bonuses based on vendor growth, quality, and volume.



## How to Apply



Please apply with your resume and a short note explaining your experience managing vendors, affiliates, lead sources, call centers, or similar relationships.



Bonus points if you have experience in insurance, lead generation, pay-per-call, or performance marketing.

· VAs who need a US number so international clients take them

  seriously

· OFWs who need to keep their Philippine number active for OTP

  and bank messages

· Travelers who want internet the moment they land



We are now opening the Philippine market, and we are hiring the

person who will build our local team from zero.



?????????????????????????????



THE ROLE



You will build and lead our network of local partners — people who

promote our service through their own social media channels.



This is not a back-office HR job. You will be the person who finds

them, trains them, keeps them going, and represents our company to

them every day.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

· Recruit local partners across the Philippines

· Onboard and train them using our materials (handbook, videos,

  scripts) — all materials are provided

· Keep partners active: regular check-ins, answer questions,

  solve problems

· Monitor what partners post and make sure it follows our

  communication standards

· Track performance and send a weekly report to the founder

· Tell us honestly what is working and what is not in the

  Philippine market



?????????????????????????????



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



REQUIRED

· 5+ years recruiting, managing, or leading people, including

  experience leading a team of 10 or more

  (BPO team lead / supervisor, sales manager, insurance or

  direct selling team leader, community manager — all relevant)

· Excellent written and spoken English

· Comfortable using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, or similar) in

  your daily work — we use AI heavily for training materials,

  translation, and communication, and we will teach you our

  workflow

· Strong, stable internet and a quiet place to make calls

· Organized: you keep records, you follow up, nothing slips

· Self-managed: nobody will be watching over your shoulder,

  and we need results anyway

· Honest and direct — we are overseas and cannot see the ground

  truth. We need someone who tells us bad news early.



NICE TO HAVE

· Experience managing people who are not employees

  (agents, freelancers, resellers, downlines)

· Experience with
/Messenger-based outreach

· Experience training people who are new to online work



?????????????????????????????



IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING



We are a real telecom service selling a real product.



We NEVER promise specific income to anyone, and neither will you.

Any partner who makes income promises will be removed from our

program, and we expect you to enforce this.



If you are looking for a role where you can tell people they will

get rich, please do not apply. If you value working for a company

that does things properly, we want to talk to you.



?????????????????????????????



WHAT WE OFFER

· Full-time, long-term, stable position — not a project

· PHP 40,000 – 70,000/month (approx. USD 700 – 1,200)

  + performance bonus

· You build the Philippine operation from day one. Real ownership,

  real influence on how we do things.

· Direct working relationship with the founder — no layers of

  management between you and the decision maker

· All training materials, systems, and AI tools provided — we

  work with modern AI workflows, so you spend your time on

  people, not paperwork



?????????????????????????????



HOW TO APPLY



Applications without the video will not be reviewed.



Send us:

1. Your CV or OnlineJobs profile link

2. A 2-MINUTE VIDEO INTRODUCTION IN ENGLISH, answering:

   a. Your experience recruiting or leading people

   b. The Most difficult situation with a team member — what happened

      and how you handled it

   c. Why this role interests you

   A phone recording is fine. We care about what you say,

   not production quality.

3. Start your message with the word "BEES" so we know you read

   this post completely.



We reply to every applicant who follows these instructions.



Eddie Chen

Founder, Bees Mobile
